sentences.en: In 2011, the body of a woman was discovered in a California vineyard.
sentences.zh: 2011年，在加利福尼亚州的一处葡萄园内发现了一具女性尸体。

sentences.en: She had been decapitated, and her body had been drained of blood.
sentences.zh: 她被斩首，且体内的血已被放干。

sentences.en: It appeared her killer had gone to extraordinary lengths to conceal her identity.
sentences.zh: 凶手似乎费尽了心思来隐瞒她的身份。

sentences.en: For more than a decade, she was known only as Jane Doe.
sentences.zh: 十多年来，人们只知道她叫无名女尸。

sentences.en: Then, detectives finally learned her name, Ada.
sentences.zh: 随后，侦探们终于得知了她的名字——艾达。

sentences.en: But, identifying her only made this bizarre murder even more perplexing.
sentences.zh: 然而，确认她的身份却让这起离奇的谋杀案变得更加扑朔迷离。

sentences.en: Ada is the new series from Casefile Presents, available now, wherever you get your podcasts.
sentences.zh: 《艾达》是“案件档案呈现”推出的全新系列，现已上线，各大播客平台均可收听。

sentences.zh: 比如卡洛驰、尼曼百货和Ulta。

sentences.zh: 当你在本季最大规模的促销活动中叠加现金返还时，你能省下更多。

sentences.en: And beyond the gifts, you can save on decor, travel, and maybe a little something for yourself.
sentences.zh: 除了礼品，你还可以在装饰、旅行上省钱，或许还能给自己买点小礼物。

sentences.en: It is the most rewarding time of the year, after all.
sentences.zh: 毕竟，这是一年中回报最丰厚的时刻。

sentences.en: And when it's time to redeem your earnings, choose from PayPal, check, belt points, or gift cards.
sentences.zh: 当需要兑换收益时，你可以选择PayPal、支票、积分或礼品卡。

sentences.zh: 符合条件的美国运通卡会员可以选择赚取会员奖励积分，而不是现金返还。

sentences.zh: 条款和条件适用。

sentences.zh: 我们的节目涉及严重且通常令人痛心的事件。
