sentences.en: Nestled in the centre of a clearing hidden amongst tall birch and pine trees was a small, light-coloured, A-frame tent.
sentences.zh: 在高大的桦树和松树环绕的一处隐秘林间空地的中央，坐落着一顶浅色的小型A字形帐篷。

sentences.en: Ruth Collie had spotted it as she wandered through the glade with her five-year-old daughter.
sentences.zh: 露丝·科利带着五岁的女儿在林间空地漫步时，发现了它。

sentences.en: The secluded campsite overlooked Lake Budum's clear and tranquil waters from a vantage point along the eastern peninsula.
sentences.zh: 这个隐蔽的营地位于东部半岛的一个观景处，俯瞰着布杜姆湖清澈宁静的湖水。

sentences.en: The tent itself was not an unusual find.
sentences.zh: 帐篷本身并不是什么罕见的发现。

sentences.en: Located in southern Finland, Lake Budum was a hive of activity on the morning of Sunday, June 5, 1960.
sentences.zh: 布杜姆湖位于芬兰南部，在1960年6月5日星期日的早晨，这里是一片热闹的活动中心。

sentences.en: With the ice and snow blanketing the countryside having long since melted away, outdoor enthusiasts had flocked to the lake to swim, sunbathe and go fishing.
sentences.zh: 覆盖乡村的冰雪早已融化，户外爱好者们蜂拥至湖边游泳、晒日光浴和钓鱼。

sentences.en: Some opted to camp throughout the patch of forest framing the three-kilometre-long waterfront.
sentences.zh: 有些人选择在环绕三公里长水岸的这片森林中露营。

sentences.en: When Ruth Collie stumbled across one such campsite, it was far from surprising.
sentences.zh: 当露丝·科利偶然发现这样一个营地时，这并不足为奇。

sentences.en: Yet, something drew her closer into the quiet clearing.
sentences.zh: 然而，有什么东西吸引着她走近这片安静的空地。

sentences.en: Its centrepiece, the A-frame tent, had collapsed in on itself.
sentences.zh: 作为核心的A字形帐篷已经塌陷了。

sentences.en: There were several people seemingly asleep amid the disarray.
sentences.zh: 在一片混乱中，似乎有几个人在睡觉。

sentences.en: It was difficult to distinguish what was what in the tangle of limbs, hair and belongings, but Ruth could see two teenage girls lying more or less side by side.
sentences.zh: 在一团纠缠不清的四肢、头发和随身物品中很难分辨出什么是什么，但露丝可以看到两个十几岁的女孩大致并排躺着。

sentences.en: A boy about the same age lay slightly apart from them.
sentences.zh: 一个年龄相仿的男孩离他们稍远一点。

sentences.en: Then there was a second adolescent male who was more exposed than his friends.
sentences.zh: 然后是第二个青少年男性，他比他的朋友们暴露得更多。

sentences.en: He was lying on his back, directly on top of the tent, with his legs bent.
sentences.zh: 他仰面躺着，直接压在帐篷上，双腿弯曲。

sentences.en: His face was smeared with blood and flies buzzed around his head.
sentences.zh: 他的脸上满是血迹，苍蝇在他的头周围嗡嗡直叫。

sentences.en: Bottles of alcohol scattered around the area led Ruth to suspect she was looking at the fallout
sentences.zh: 散落在周围的酒瓶让露丝怀疑她看到的是

sentences.en: of a drunken and violent argument between some young campers, who were now sleeping off their hangovers.
sentences.zh: 一群年轻露营者之间发生争执后的残局，他们当时正在酒后暴力争吵，现在正宿醉未醒。

sentences.en: She moved away and continued along the peninsula with her daughter to meet up with the rest of their family.
sentences.zh: 她带着女儿走开，顺着半岛继续前行，去和家里的其他人汇合。

sentences.en: Soon, Ruth spotted her husband Marty and their son in their fishing boat about 200 metres offshore.
sentences.zh: 不久，露丝看到她的丈夫马蒂和他们的儿子正在离岸约200米的渔船上。

sentences.en: She waved them over.
sentences.zh: 她挥手让他们过来。

sentences.en: Marty Collie rode over to where his wife and daughter were waiting.
sentences.zh: 马蒂·科利把船划到妻子和女儿等待的地方。

sentences.en: Ruth informed him about the four teenagers camping nearby and Marty decided to check on them.
sentences.zh: 露丝把附近有四个青少年在露营的事告诉了他，马蒂决定去查看一下。

sentences.en: He strode up the ridge and was confronted by the same confusing scene that had troubled his wife.
sentences.zh: 他大步走上山脊，迎面看到的就是让他妻子感到不安的那个令人费解的场景。

sentences.en: Marty recognised the teens.
sentences.zh: 马蒂认出了这些年轻人。

sentences.en: He had seen them arrive the previous day.
sentences.zh: 他前一天见过他们抵达。

sentences.en: At around 5pm, the group of four had roared up to the south side of the lake on two motorcycles.
sentences.zh: 下午5点左右，这四个年轻人骑着两辆摩托车轰鸣着来到湖的南侧。

sentences.en: The boys were driving, and each had a girl clinging to his back.
sentences.zh: 男孩们开车，每个人的背上都挂着一个女孩。

sentences.en: They'd seemed like a happy group, all smiles and laughter.
sentences.zh: 他们看起来像是一群快乐的人，满脸笑容和欢声笑语。

sentences.en: Marty leaned in closer to inspect the mess before him.
sentences.zh: 马蒂凑近去检查眼前的狼藉。

sentences.en: As he gazed at the tent's filthy and collapsed canvas, he realised that large swaths of it had been slashed open with a knife.
sentences.zh: 当他凝视着帐篷肮脏且坍塌的帆布时，他意识到很大一部分都被刀划破了。

sentences.en: Nils Gustafsson and Sepol Boisman had been best friends since they were 12 years old.
sentences.zh: 尼尔斯·古斯塔夫森和塞波·博伊斯曼从12岁起就是最好的朋友。

sentences.en: With just four months between them, the pair were inseparable and frequently had sleepovers at each other's homes.
sentences.zh: 两人年龄只相差四个月，形影不离，经常在彼此家里过夜。

sentences.en: As they grew older, their lives followed similar paths.
sentences.zh: 随着年龄的增长，他们的人生轨迹也相似。

sentences.en: They became electricians after graduating school and gained employment at the same electromechanical plant.
sentences.zh: 他们从学校毕业后成为了电工，并在同一家机电厂找到了工作。

sentences.en: By May of 1960, Sepol had turned 18 and was dating 15-year-old high school student Anya Mackie, who went by her middle name of Tullicki.
sentences.zh: 到1960年5月，塞波已经18岁了，正在和15岁的高中生安雅·麦基交往，大家都叫她的中间名图莉基。

sentences.en: Tullicki introduced Sepol and Nils to her own best friend, Myla Björklund.
sentences.zh: 图莉基把塞波和尼尔斯介绍给了她自己最好的朋友米拉·比约克隆德。

sentences.en: She was also 15 and was known by her middle name, Irmeli.
sentences.zh: 她也是15岁，人们用她的中间名伊梅利称呼她。

sentences.en: Irmeli was charmed by Nils, with his slicked-back brown hair and rockabilly fashion sense inspired by the king of rock and roll, Elvis Presley.
sentences.zh: 伊梅利被尼尔斯那向后梳的棕色头发以及受摇滚之王埃尔维斯·普雷斯利启发的摇滚abilly时尚风格所吸引。

sentences.en: The pair officially became a couple just after Nils' 18th birthday.
sentences.zh: 在尼尔斯18岁生日后不久，两人正式确立了恋爱关系。

sentences.en: About two weeks later, the four teenagers decided that an overnight camping trip to Lake Boodham would be a great way to celebrate the start of the holidays.
sentences.zh: 大约两周后，这四个青少年决定去博德姆湖进行一次过夜露营，以此来庆祝假期的开始。

sentences.en: Irmeli was particularly excited about the upcoming break, as it was the first summer where she wasn't needed to look after her two younger brothers.
sentences.zh: 伊梅利对即将到来的假期格外兴奋，因为这是她第一个不需要照顾两个弟弟的夏天。

sentences.en: Despite the girls' excitement, their parents were reluctant to give their blessing for the trip.
sentences.zh: 尽管女孩们很兴奋，但她们的父母对这次旅行并不太情愿给予祝福。

sentences.en: Although they had always found Sepol and Nils respectful and trustworthy, the idea of their young daughters staying out overnight didn't sit right.
sentences.zh: 尽管他们一直觉得塞波和尼尔斯很有礼貌且值得信赖，但一想到年轻的女儿们要在外面过夜，他们总觉得哪里不对劲。

sentences.en: Eventually, both Irmeli and Tullicki's parents relented and they were permitted to go.
sentences.zh: 最终，伊梅利和图莉基的父母都心软了，允许他们去。

sentences.en: The boys fared much easier.
sentences.zh: 男孩们则要顺利得多。

sentences.en: Sepol convinced his mother and father that the trip would be safe, as the lake was only a 30-minute drive northwest from their home city of Helsinki.
sentences.zh: 塞波说服了他的父母，这次旅行会很安全，因为湖泊距离他们居住的城市赫尔辛基西北方向只有30分钟的车程。

sentences.en: It wasn't as though they would be camping in some remote wilderness.
sentences.zh: 这又不是要在什么偏远的荒野里露营。

sentences.en: Nils' parents had no problem with him camping and fishing with Sepol for the night, although Nils failed to mention that the girls would be with them.
sentences.zh: 尼尔斯的父母对他在外面和塞波露营并过夜钓鱼没有什么意见，不过尼尔斯没有提女孩们会和他们一起去。

sentences.en: And so it was settled.
sentences.zh: 事情就这么定下来了。

sentences.en: On Saturday June 4, 1960, Sepol, Nils, Tullicki and Irmeli would venture to Lake Boodham.
sentences.zh: 1960年6月4日星期六，塞波、尼尔斯、图莉基和伊梅利将前往博德姆湖。

sentences.en: The timing was perfect for the young couples, as they would wake up together on the morning of the Christian holiday known as PentecoSt.
sentences.zh: 对于这对年轻的情侣来说，时机再好不过了，因为他们将在被称为圣灵降临节的基督教节日的早晨一起醒来。

sentences.en: In Finland, there was a saying,
sentences.zh: 在芬兰，有一句俗语：

sentences.en: If you don't have a sweetheart on Pentecost, you won't have one all summer.
sentences.zh: 如果你在圣灵降临节没有甜心，你整个夏天都不会有。

sentences.en: Sepol borrowed a canvas tent from work and got his hands on some alcohol, a half-liter bottle of Salmasari liquor, a 370-milliliter bottle of citrus liquor,
sentences.zh: 塞波从工作单位借了一个帆布帐篷，并弄到了一些酒，包括一瓶半升的萨尔马萨里烈酒、一瓶370毫升的柑橘烈酒，

sentences.en: and a couple of pale lagers.
sentences.zh: 以及几瓶淡色拉格啤酒。

sentences.en: The boys packed bread, sausages, snacks, snacks, and fishing equipment, as well as various knives and a pair of pliers to use as tools.
sentences.zh: 男孩们带上了面包、香肠、各种零食、钓鱼装备，以及各种刀具和一把用来当工具的钳子。

sentences.en: By Saturday afternoon, Nils and Sepol were cruising to Lake Boodham on their motorcycles, their girlfriends clinging tightly to their respective backs.
sentences.zh: 到星期六下午，尼尔斯和塞波尔骑着摩托车前往布德姆湖，他们的女友紧紧抓着各自的后背。

sentences.en: At about 5pm, they pulled up to the south side of the lake and found the ideal camping spot at the tip of a small peninsula.
sentences.zh: 下午5点左右，他们把车停在湖的南侧，在一个小半岛的尖端找到了理想的露营地。

sentences.en: It was a short walk east from the lake's main swimming area, but was screened off from the beach by another small peninsula in between.
sentences.zh: 从湖的主游泳区向东走一小段路就到，但中间隔着另一个小半岛，把这里与海滩隔离开来。

sentences.en: They unloaded their bags in a clearing that overlooked the lake.
sentences.zh: 他们在能俯瞰湖景的一处空地上卸下了背包。

sentences.en: Rather than setting up camp right away, they fired up the motorbikes again and headed back about a kilometre down the road to a kiosk they had passed on the way in.
sentences.zh: 他们没有马上搭帐篷，而是重新发动摩托车，顺着来时的路往回开了一公里左右，来到了一家他们一路上经过的小卖部。

sentences.en: There, the boys bought several packets of chewing gum and a few bottles of soft drink as mixers for their liquors.
sentences.zh: 在那里，男孩们买了甘草口香糖和几瓶软饮料，用来兑他们的烈酒。

sentences.en: By the time the group arrived back at their campsite, it was about 7.15pm.
sentences.zh: 当这群人回到营地时，大约已经是晚上7点15分了。

sentences.en: There were still a few swimmers in the water, but their numbers were dwindling.
sentences.zh: 水里还有几个游泳的人，但人数已经越来越少了。

sentences.en: Nils and Sepol unrolled the tent with the opening facing east, away from the swimming beach.
sentences.zh: 尼尔斯和塞波尔展开了帐篷，开口朝东，背对游泳海滩。

sentences.en: They cut some thick birch sticks from the trees and sharpened them into makeshift tent poles.
sentences.zh: 他们从树上砍下一些粗壮的桦木树枝，削尖当做临时帐篷杆。

sentences.en: One of the boys found a decent-sized rock down by the shore and used it to hammer the stakes into the ground.
sentences.zh: 其中一个男孩在岸边找到一块大小合适的石头，用来把地钉敲进地里。

sentences.en: Then they tied off the guy lines and stepped back to admire their handiwork.
sentences.zh: 然后他们绑好防风绳，退后一步欣赏他们的手艺。

sentences.en: It was a typical A-frame tent, which stood at 113cm at its highest point through the middle, not tall enough for any of them to stand inside.
sentences.zh: 这是一个典型的A字形帐篷，中间最高处为113厘米，高度不够让他们任何人在里面站立。

sentences.en: At 138cm wide, it barely had room for two, but the four teens would make it work.
sentences.zh: 宽度为138厘米，勉强能容纳两个人，但这四个青少年还是决定挤一挤。

sentences.en: It was just going to be a very tight fit.
sentences.zh: 只是空间会非常狭窄。

sentences.en: Early the next morning, two teenage friends were strolling along the southern shore of Lake Bulldom.
sentences.zh: 第二天清晨，两个十几岁的男孩正在布尔多姆湖南岸散步。

sentences.en: Just before 6am, the boys reached the eastern peninsula when they heard a voice.
sentences.zh: 将近早上6点时，男孩们走到东半岛附近，听到一个声音。

sentences.en: Drawn to the sound, they climbed up a ridge and into the surrounding woodland to investigate.
sentences.zh: 循着声音，他们爬上一道山脊，进入周围的林地查看。

sentences.en: There, they spotted two motorcycles leaning up against some birch trees.
sentences.zh: 在那里，他们发现两辆摩托车靠在几棵桦木上。

sentences.en: Behind them, in a clearing, was a collapsed tent.
sentences.zh: 在它们后面的空地上，有一个塌掉的帐篷。

sentences.en: The boys were certain that a man was lying on top of it.
sentences.zh: 男孩们确信有一个人正躺在它上面。

sentences.en: They couldn't see his face, but they spotted a pair of legs in dark trousers.
sentences.zh: 他们看不清他的脸，但看到了一双穿着深色裤子的腿。

sentences.en: It looked like he was stirring slightly.
sentences.zh: 看起来他稍微动了一下。

sentences.en: Then, some activity a little further away caught their attention.
sentences.zh: 接着，更远处的一点动静吸引了他们的注意。

sentences.en: Another man was heading away from the tent into the trees.
sentences.zh: 另一个人正从帐篷走向树林深处。

sentences.en: The boys didn't see his face, but he looked to be an adult wearing a light-coloured shirt.
sentences.zh: 男孩们没有看清他的脸，但他看起来像是一个穿着浅色衬衫的成年人。

sentences.en: They couldn't tell which direction he headed after reaching the trees.
sentences.zh: 他们分不清他进入树林后朝哪个方向走去了。

sentences.en: Perhaps he'd stopped walking once he was hidden from view.
sentences.zh: 也许他一走到视线之外就停下脚步了。

sentences.en: The boys wanted to take a closer look at the motorcycles, but decided they shouldn't risk disturbing the campers, and left.
sentences.zh: 男孩们想凑近看看那些摩托车，但觉得不应该冒险打扰露营者，便离开了。

sentences.en: Fourteen-year-old Olivie Kivillati was perched on a rocky outcropping overlooking Lake Bulldom, waiting for his fishing buddy.
sentences.zh: 14岁的奥利维·基维拉蒂正盘坐在一处俯瞰布尔多姆湖的岩石露头上，等待着他的钓鱼伙伴。

sentences.en: The sun had already risen by the time he'd arrived, and the morning was calm and quiet.
sentences.zh: 他到达时太阳已经升起，早晨宁静祥和。

sentences.en: Then, at about 6am, Olivie's solitude was broken by a man emerging from some trees near the base of the eastern peninsula, about 80 metres away.
sentences.zh: 随后，大约早上6点，一个男人从东半岛基部附近的树林里钻出来，打破了奥利维的清静，距离大约80米远。

sentences.en: He looked to be in his twenties, was of average height, and had brown hair combed backwards.
sentences.zh: 他看起来二十多岁，中等身材，留着向后梳的棕色头发。

sentences.en: He was wearing a light top and dark pants.
sentences.zh: 他穿着一件浅色上衣和深色裤子。

sentences.en: The man moved quickly and purposefully down to the peninsula's base, and continued south, before disappearing out of Olivie's sight.
sentences.zh: 那名男子动作迅速而坚定地走到半岛根基处，继续向南走去，随后消失在奥利维的视线中。

sentences.en: It was several hours later when Ruth Colley discovered the collapsed tent and pointed it out to her husband.
sentences.zh: 几个小时后，露丝·科利发现了倒塌的帐篷，并指给她丈夫看。

sentences.en: By 10am, more people had noticed the tent, including a group of teenagers who had been swimming in the lake.
sentences.zh: 到了上午10点，更多人注意到了这个帐篷，其中包括一群曾在湖里游泳的青少年。

sentences.en: They too thought it looked as though the young campers had been in a fight, and carried on with their mourning.
sentences.zh: 他们也觉得年轻的露营者像是打过架，随后继续他们的哀悼。

sentences.en: Then, at 11.15am, a passer-by realised something far more sinister had taken place, and rushed to a nearby construction site.
sentences.zh: 接着，上午11点15分，一名路人意识到发生了更阴险的事情，急忙赶往附近的一个建筑工地。

sentences.en: Using the phone in its office to call the police, he informed them that there had been a slaughter at Lake Bulldom.
sentences.zh: 他用办公室的电话报警，通报布尔多姆湖发生了一起屠杀。

sentences.en: Upon observing the campsite for themselves, local officers immediately contacted the central criminal police.
sentences.zh: 当地警员亲自视察营地后，立即联系了中央刑警。

sentences.en: Special investigators arrived and examined the bodies bundled close together.
sentences.zh: 特警调查人员赶到现场，检查了紧紧挤在一起的尸体。

sentences.en: Sepul Boisman was lying under the folds at the edge of the tent.
sentences.zh: 塞普尔·博伊斯曼躺在帐篷边缘的褶皱下。

sentences.en: His legs, dressed in blue jeans that were unbuttoned at the fly, were outstretched.
sentences.zh: 他的双腿伸直，穿着一条裤门拉链没扣上的蓝色牛仔裤。

sentences.en: He also wore a blue-collared shirt, and his hands rested on his chest, almost as if he was sleeping.
sentences.zh: 他还穿着一件蓝色翻领衬衫，双手放在胸前，几乎就像是在睡觉。

sentences.en: But Sepul was not asleep.
sentences.zh: 但塞普尔并没有睡觉。

sentences.en: He had been hit with a blunt object multiple times in the head and jaw, producing four fractures to the left side of his skull.
sentences.zh: 他的头部和下巴多次遭到钝器击打，导致头骨左侧出现四处骨折。

sentences.en: Curious onlookers watched as a police officer lifted one of the tent folds that covered Sepul's head, revealing that he had also been stabbed through the tent's canvas.
sentences.zh: 好奇的旁观者看着一名警察掀开覆盖着塞普尔头部的帐篷褶皱，发现他也通过帐篷帆布被刺伤了。

sentences.en: There were wounds in his neck and trachea.
sentences.zh: 他的颈部和气管有伤口。

sentences.en: The fatal strike was another stab wound that had punctured Sepul's chest cavity.
sentences.zh: 致命的一击是另一处刺伤，刺穿了塞普尔的胸腔。

sentences.en: He would not have been able to move before he bled out into his lungs.
sentences.zh: 在他血液流干进肺部之前，他根本无法动弹。

sentences.en: His girlfriend, Tulikimaki, was curled up face down and partially covered with a blanket.
sentences.zh: 他的女友图利基玛基面朝下蜷缩着，身上半盖着一条毯子。

sentences.en: Her blue jeans were fastened, but her yellow blouse had ridden up her torso, exposing her midriff.
sentences.zh: 她的蓝色牛仔裤系着扣子，但黄色衬衫向上掀到了躯干，露出了腹部。

sentences.en: She too had suffered severe blunt force trauma to her head, which caused multiple fractures to her skull.
sentences.zh: 她的头部也遭受了严重的钝力创伤，导致头骨多处骨折。

sentences.en: Irmeli Björklund was near the tent's doorway, her left leg parallel to Tuliki's back, and her right leg bent around Tuliki's head.
sentences.zh: 伊尔梅利·比约克伦德在帐篷门口附近，她的左腿与图利基的背部平行，右腿弯曲环绕着图利基的头部。

sentences.en: Irmeli's light green jeans were down below her knees, with the right pant leg pulled off entirely, exposing her lower half.
sentences.zh: 伊尔梅利的浅绿色牛仔裤退到了膝盖以下，右裤腿完全被脱掉，露出了下半身。

sentences.en: Her beige blouse and light blue sweater had also been pulled up to her shoulders, exposing her torso and bra.
sentences.zh: 她的米色衬衫和浅蓝色毛衣也被推到了肩膀上，露出了躯干和胸罩。

sentences.en: At least three powerful strikes with a blunt heavy object had shattered Irmeli's skull across her forehead and produced further fractures along her jaw and the side of her face.
sentences.zh: 用沉重钝器进行的至少三次猛烈击打击碎了伊尔梅利前额处的头骨，并在她的下巴和面部侧面造成了进一步的骨折。

sentences.en: These blows were enough to cause severe swelling and bleeding of the brain, resulting in almost immediate death.
sentences.zh: 这些打击足以引起大脑严重肿胀和出血，导致几乎瞬间死亡。

sentences.en: But the killer had also stabbed Irmeli 15 times in her neck and shoulders.
sentences.zh: 但凶手还对伊尔梅利的颈部和肩膀捅了15刀。

sentences.en: She had clearly borne the brunt of the attack.
sentences.zh: 她显然承受了袭击的主要冲击。

sentences.en: Nils Gustafsson was lying on top of the tent, dressed in a grey sweater, dark jeans and socks.
sentences.zh: 尼尔斯·古斯塔夫森趴在帐篷顶上，穿着灰色毛衣、深色牛仔裤和袜子。

sentences.en: The entire left side of his face was swollen and bruised, including his eye, which was sealed shut.
sentences.zh: 他整个左半边脸又肿又青，包括眼睛也被肿得紧闭。

sentences.en: Nils had suffered a fracture to the left side of his lower jaw and another to the temporal bone, otherwise known as the ear canal.
sentences.zh: 尼尔斯的下巴左侧和颞骨（也就是耳道）发生了骨折。

sentences.en: The left side of his upper jaw and his cheekbone were also fractured.
sentences.zh: 他上颌的左侧和颧骨也骨折了。

sentences.en: Nils had been slashed multiple times with a knife.
sentences.zh: 尼尔斯曾被刀多次砍伤。

sentences.en: He had a gash on the back of his left forearm and another along his left cheek.
sentences.zh: 他的左前臂背面有一道伤口，左脸颊上也有一道。

sentences.en: This second wound was so deep it had cut through the entire depth of skin and muscle, exposing his teeth.
sentences.zh: 这第二道伤口太深了，甚至切透了整层皮肤和肌肉，露出了他的牙齿。

sentences.en: Police determined that the killer had intentionally cut the tent's guy lines before the attack.
sentences.zh: 警方确定，凶手在袭击前蓄意割断了帐篷的防风绳。

sentences.en: As the tent collapsed onto the sleeping teens, the exact location of each of their heads would have become obvious.
sentences.zh: 当帐篷塌落在睡觉的青少年身上时，他们每个人头部准确的位置就会变得显而易见。

sentences.en: The four victims were effectively trapped, confused and disoriented, with no means of escape.
sentences.zh: 这四名受害者实际上被困住了，困惑且不知所措，没有逃生手段。

sentences.en: The killer would not have known the order in which they were sleeping, so he likely unleashed the violent blitz attack indiscriminately.
sentences.zh: 凶手不会知道他们睡觉的顺序，因此他很可能是无差别地发动了暴力突袭。

sentences.en: Items recovered at the crime scene correlated with what the teens had packed for their weekend getaway.
sentences.zh: 在犯罪现场找回的物品与青少年为周末度假打包的行李相吻合。

sentences.en: Bags, clothing, cigarette boxes, make-up, bread, and a red leather songbook that belonged to Tuliki were catalogued.
sentences.zh: 行李箱、衣物、烟盒、化妆品、面包，以及属于图利基的红色皮革歌词本都被登记在册。

sentences.en: Two table knives and two pocket knives were found, but none were the bladed weapon wielded by the killer.
sentences.zh: 警方发现了两把餐刀和两把折叠刀，但都不是凶手行凶时使用的带刃武器。

sentences.en: The pale lager bottles were found, one empty, one full, along with multiple bottles of soda.
sentences.zh: 现场找到了淡色拉格啤酒瓶，一空一满，还有多个苏打水瓶。

sentences.en: Some of the soda bottles were empty, but one still contained a mix of soft drink and the citrus liquor.
sentences.zh: 其中一些苏打水瓶是空的，但有一个瓶子里仍然装着软饮料和柑橘类利口酒的混合液体。

sentences.en: A foreign fingerprint not belonging to any of the teens was found on one bottle.
sentences.zh: 在一个瓶子上发现了一枚不属于任何青少年的外地人指纹。

sentences.en: The bottle of Saumisari liquor was never located.
sentences.zh: 索米萨里利口酒的瓶子始终没有找到。

sentences.en: Other, more crucial items were also missing.
sentences.zh: 其他更关键的物品也失踪了。

sentences.en: Notably, each of the teenagers' wallets and IDs, another knife they had packed,
sentences.zh: 值得注意的是，每个青少年的钱包和身份证件、他们随身携带的另一把刀，

sentences.en: Seppo's leather jacket, and the keys to the motorcycles.
sentences.zh: 谢波的皮夹克，以及摩托车的钥匙全都失踪了。

sentences.en: The girls hadn't brought any watches, but the boys had, and they were missing too.
sentences.zh: 女孩们没有带手表，但男孩们带了，而手表也不见了。

sentences.en: Over the next day or two, community volunteers joined police and military personnel in an extensive search of the entire Lake Buldum area.
sentences.zh: 在接下来的两天里，社区志愿者与警察和军方人员一起，对整个布尔杜姆湖地区进行了地毯式搜查。

sentences.en: Metal detectors were used and sniffer dogs were deployed, while divers searched the depths of the lake.
sentences.zh: 警方动用了金属探测器并部署了警犬，同时潜水员搜寻了湖底深处。

sentences.en: Items as small as a piece of iron wire were collected.
sentences.zh: 连一小段铁丝这样微小的物品都被收集了起来。

sentences.en: The weapons used in the attack were not located.
sentences.zh: 袭击中使用的凶器并未找到。

sentences.en: About 500 metres from the crime scene, just off the road that led to the campsite, a pair of worn brown leather slip-on loafers were found hidden under a rock.
sentences.zh: 在距离犯罪现场约500米、通往营地的公路旁，人们在一块大石头下发现了一双藏匿的旧棕色皮质一脚蹬乐福鞋。

sentences.en: They were covered in flecks of blood and were identified as belonging to victim Nils Gustafsson.
sentences.zh: 鞋上沾满了血迹斑点，经辨认属于受害者尼尔斯·古斯塔夫松。

sentences.en: Seppo Boisman's shoes were also unearthed nearby, discarded more carelessly in the scrub on the other side of the road.
sentences.zh: 谢波·博伊斯曼的鞋子也在附近被挖出，它们被更随意地扔在公路另一侧的灌木丛中。

sentences.en: An appeal was made to identify the man seen walking away from the campsite the morning the bodies were discovered.
sentences.zh: 警方呼吁公众协助辨认在发现尸体的清晨被看到离开营地的男子。

sentences.en: While this particular individual wasn't identified, sightings of other suspicious persons were called in.
sentences.zh: 尽管这名特定的个人未能被确认身份，但人们打来电话报告了其他可疑人员的目击情报。

sentences.en: Given the brutality and shocking nature of the murders, the provincial government ordered police teams to apprehend all suspects immediately.
sentences.zh: 鉴于凶杀案的残酷性和骇人性质，省政府下令警方团队立即抓捕所有嫌疑人。

sentences.en: Dozens of people were brought into police stations across the county for interrogations.
sentences.zh: 数十人被带到该县各地的警察局接受审讯。

sentences.en: One man was arrested based on the suspicions of a bishop.
sentences.zh: 一名男子根据一位主教的怀疑而被捕。

sentences.en: A soldier was also detained after his parents tipped off the police.
sentences.zh: 一名士兵也在其父母向警方举报后被拘留。

sentences.en: Both were eventually released.
sentences.zh: 两人最终都被释放了。

sentences.en: In one more promising lead, a man was arrested when a bloody knife was found in Bulldom village.
sentences.zh: 在另一个更有希望的线索中，一名男子在布尔杜姆村被捕，当时警方在那里发现了一把带血的刀。

sentences.en: After tests proved that the blood didn't match any of the victim's blood types, he was let go.
sentences.zh: 经测试证明血迹与任何受害者的血型都不匹配后，他被释放了。

sentences.en: A bearded, dirty man spotted hiding out in the Bulldom forest area was found to be a fugitive named Paoli Luoma.
sentences.zh: 一个留着胡子、衣衫褴褛的男人被发现藏匿在布尔杜姆森林区，经查他是一名名叫保利·洛马的逃犯。

sentences.en: Luoma had received a mandatory labour order, likely for vagrancy, which was then a crime in Finland, but had deserted his sentence.
sentences.zh: 洛马曾收到一份强制劳教令，很可能是因为流浪——这在当时的芬兰是违法的，但他逃避了刑罚。

sentences.en: A large-scale manhunt began.
sentences.zh: 一场大规模的搜捕行动开始了。

sentences.en: The police managed to locate Luoma, but he was so drunk that they had to keep him in a holding cell overnight to sober up before they could interrogate him.
sentences.zh: 警方设法找到了洛马，但他醉得不省人事，以至于警方不得不把他关在拘留室里过夜，等他酒醒后才能审讯他。

sentences.en: When Luoma was interviewed the next morning, he was able to name nearly a dozen witnesses who confirmed he had been in a hut outside of Helsinki at the time of the murders.
sentences.zh: 第二天早晨接受盘问时，洛马说出了近一打证人的名字，他们证实谋杀发生时他在赫尔辛基郊外的一座小屋里。

sentences.en: Although the police investigation seemed to be stalling, locals were working on theories of their own.
sentences.zh: 尽管警方调查似乎陷入停滞，但当地人却在研究他们自己的推测。

sentences.en: 51-year-old Carl Gilstrom ran the kiosk near the southern part of the lake, where visitors often stopped for refreshments and supplies.
sentences.zh: 51岁的卡尔·吉尔斯特罗姆经营着湖泊南侧附近的小卖部，游客经常在那里停留购买茶点和补给品。

sentences.en: He also lived in a house a short distance up the road.
sentences.zh: 他同时也住在离路边不远的一所房子里。

sentences.en: Gilstrom was of average height and had dark hair that he wore slicked back across his head, but the most notable thing about him was his temper.
sentences.zh: 吉尔斯特罗姆身材中等，留着向后梳理的黑发，但他最显着的特征是他的脾气。

sentences.en: Although he could be friendly and polite, especially when authority figures were around, sometimes his mood would flick like a switch.
sentences.zh: 虽然他有时会表现得友好而礼貌，特别是在权威人物在场时，但有时他的情绪会像开关一样翻转。

sentences.en: Suddenly, he'd turn aggressive and cruel.
sentences.zh: 转瞬间，他就会变得充满攻击性和残忍。

sentences.en: Locals said that he hid razorblades in the apples that grew from his tree, to deter children from picking the fruit.
sentences.zh: 当地人说，他在自家树上结出的苹果里藏着剃须刀片，以此阻止孩子们采摘果实。

sentences.en: A heavy drinker with a known hatred of the campers who stayed at the lake, Gilstrom was also prone to attacking others.
sentences.zh: 吉尔斯特罗姆是一个酗酒者，以痛恨在湖边露营的游客而闻名，并且还容易攻击他人。

sentences.en: A man who owned land near the lake once caught Gilstrom hunting illegally and asked him to leave.
sentences.zh: 一个在湖附近拥有土地的人曾抓到吉尔斯特罗姆非法打猎，并要求他离开。

sentences.en: Gilstrom raised his shotgun, took aim, then fired at the man.
sentences.zh: 吉尔斯特罗姆举起猎枪，瞄准，然后向那个人开枪。

sentences.en: He wasn't seriously hurt, but he had to have the shot pellets removed at a hospital.
sentences.zh: 他伤得并不严重，但必须在医院取出散弹弹丸。

sentences.en: The road leading to his home seemed to be a particular fixation for Gilstrom.
sentences.zh: 通往他家的路似乎是吉尔斯特罗姆的一个特殊执念。

sentences.en: One time, a truck driver had been heading along the road, only to hear a loud crack, followed by the shattering of glass.
sentences.zh: 有一次，一名卡车司机正沿着这条路行驶，突然听到一声巨响，接着是玻璃碎裂的声音。

sentences.en: Sharp shards lodged in the driver's face and he realised that someone had shot at him, breaking one of the truck's windows.
sentences.zh: 尖锐的碎片嵌入了司机的脸，他意识到有人向他开枪，打碎了卡车的一扇窗户。

sentences.en: When Carl Gilstrom was found to be responsible, he claimed he'd only fired at the vehicle to discourage drivers from hooning down the road too faSt.
sentences.zh: 当发现卡尔·吉尔斯特罗姆是罪魁祸首时，他声称自己开枪只是为了阻止司机在路上开快车。

sentences.en: Sometimes, Gilstrom lined the road with makeshift spike strips, consisting of wooden planks with nails jutting out.
sentences.zh: 有时，吉尔斯特罗姆会在路上铺设临时的防刺带，也就是带有突出钉子的木板。

sentences.en: Gilstrom kept a length of iron pipe in his car and was known to carry a curved end hunting knife on his belt.
sentences.zh: 吉尔斯特罗姆的车里放着一段铁管，而且众所周知，他的腰带上总是挂着一把弯头猎刀。

sentences.en: He was also renowned for something else.
sentences.zh: 他也因其他事情而闻名。

sentences.en: He had a history of cutting the guylines of campers' tents.
sentences.zh: 他有割断露营者帐篷拉绳的历史。

sentences.en: When Nils Gustafsson, Seppo Boisman, Tullikimaki and Irmeli Björklund arrived at Lake Budham on June 4, they headed to Gilstrom's kiosk shortly after choosing a campsite.
sentences.zh: 6月4日，尼尔斯·古斯塔夫森、塞波·博伊斯曼、图利基马基和伊梅利·比约克隆德抵达布德姆湖，在选好营地后不久便前往吉尔斯特罗姆的小卖部。

sentences.en: Gilstrom's wife was working by herself behind the counter that day and served the four teens as they purchased soft drinks and chewing gum.
sentences.zh: 那天吉尔斯特罗姆的妻子独自在柜台后工作，接待了这四个购买软饮料和口香糖的青少年。

sentences.en: They hung around the kiosk for a little while longer, chatting, laughing and enjoying ice cream in the sun.
sentences.zh: 他们在小卖部附近多呆了一会儿，聊天、大笑，在阳光下享用冰淇淋。

sentences.en: Afterwards, they took off on their motorbikes back down the road towards their campsite, passing Gilstrom's home along the way.
sentences.zh: 之后，他们骑着摩托车沿着原路返回营地，途中经过了吉尔斯特罗姆的家。

sentences.en: Gilstrom's wife closed the kiosk at around nine that night and later told her husband about the four teenagers camping nearby.
sentences.zh: 吉尔斯特罗姆的妻子在当晚九点左右关掉了小卖部，后来把附近有四个青少年露营的事告诉了丈夫。

sentences.en: As investigators examined the grisly crime scene the next morning, one onlooker rushed to the kiosk to inform Gilstrom of the terrible crime.
sentences.zh: 第二天早上，当调查人员检查毛骨悚然的犯罪现场时，一名旁观者冲到小卖部，将这起可怕的罪行告知了吉尔斯特罗姆。

sentences.en: To his surprise, Gilstrom took the information in his stride.
sentences.zh: 令他惊讶的是，吉尔斯特罗姆对这个消息表现得很镇定。

sentences.en: In fact, he seemed utterly nonchalant.
sentences.zh: 事实上，他显得极其冷漠和不在乎。

sentences.en: Not long after the murders, locals learned that Gilstrom had filled in a well located on his property.
sentences.zh: 谋杀案发生后不久，当地人得知吉尔斯特罗姆填平了他房产内的一口水井。

sentences.en: Aware of his violent temper and dislike of campers, some speculated that Gilstrom was the killer
sentences.zh: 由于知道他脾气暴躁且讨厌露营者，一些人推测吉尔斯特罗姆就是凶手，

sentences.en: and had disposed of the murder weapons and or the teenagers' missing belongings down the well.
sentences.zh: 并且把凶器和或青少年们失踪的财物扔进了井里。

sentences.en: Their suspicions were strengthened by the discovery of Neil's and Seppo's shoes along the road that led to Gilstrom's house.
sentences.zh: 在通往吉尔斯特罗姆家的路上发现了尼尔和塞波的鞋子，这更加坚定了他们的怀疑。

sentences.en: Investigators eventually interviewed Gilstrom and his wife.
sentences.zh: 调查人员最终对吉尔斯特罗姆和他的妻子进行了盘问。

sentences.en: Both said that he was at home asleep on the evening in question.
sentences.zh: 两人都说他在事发当晚在家睡觉。

sentences.en: Gilstrom's wife explained that she and the children slept in the bedroom while Gilstrom slept in the kitchen,
sentences.zh: 吉尔斯特罗姆的妻子解释说，她和孩子们睡在卧室里，而吉尔斯特罗姆睡在厨房里，

sentences.en: but the door between the two rooms was kept open and her husband never left the house.
sentences.zh: 但两个房间之间的门一直开着，她的丈夫从未离开过房子。

sentences.en: Police searched the Gilstrom premises, though nothing of significance was uncovered.
sentences.zh: 警方搜查了吉尔斯特罗姆的住所，不过没有发现什么有价值的线索。

sentences.en: Yet, many locals felt that the police search was far from exhaustive.
sentences.zh: 然而，许多当地人认为警方的搜查远不够彻底。

sentences.en: They hadn't even examined the filled-in well.
sentences.zh: 他们甚至没有检查那口被填平的水井。

sentences.en: At 10.45pm the day after the murders, an ambulance arrived at Helsinki Surgical Hospital with an unconscious adult inside.
sentences.zh: 谋杀案发生后的第二天晚上10点45分，一辆救护车抵达赫尔辛基外科医院，车里有一个失去知觉的成年人。

sentences.en: The patient, a German-born man by the name of Hans Assmann, was wearing dirty overalls covered in red stains.
sentences.zh: 患者是一个名叫汉斯·阿斯曼的德国出生男子，穿着沾满红色污渍的肮脏工作服。

sentences.en: The same stains could be seen all over his hands.
sentences.zh: 同样的污渍遍布他的双手。

sentences.en: According to his wife who had accompanied him, Assmann had collapsed as a result of severe stomach pains.
sentences.zh: 据随行的妻子称，阿斯曼是因为剧烈胃痛而晕倒的。

sentences.en: When the doctor poked him during a responsiveness test, Assmann giggled.
sentences.zh: 当医生在反应测试中戳他时，阿斯曼咯咯地笑了起来。

sentences.en: Apparently, he had been faking his unconsciousness.
sentences.zh: 显然，他一直在伪装昏迷。

sentences.en: After Assmann's ruse was discovered, he exhibited no remorse or shame.
sentences.zh: 在阿斯曼的把戏被识破后，他没有表现出丝毫的悔意或羞耻。

sentences.en: Instead, he began threatening hospital staff and demanding that he be treated right away.
sentences.zh: 相反，他开始威胁医院工作人员，并要求马上给他治疗。

sentences.en: A medical intern was struck by Assmann's strange behaviour and kept a close eye on him during his stay.
sentences.zh: 一名实习医生对阿斯曼的奇怪行为留下了深刻印象，并在他住院期间密切注视着他。

sentences.en: At one stage, Assmann was visited by a woman who was not his wife.
sentences.zh: 在某个阶段，一个不是他妻子的女人来探望了阿斯曼。

sentences.en: The pair spoke at length in hushed tones.
sentences.zh: 两人压低了声音谈了很久。

sentences.en: Assmann also spent hours vigorously washing his hands with paint thinner to remove the red stains.
sentences.zh: 阿斯曼还花了几小时用油漆稀释剂使劲洗手，以洗掉红色的血迹。

sentences.en: According to Assmann's own claims, he had been a Nazi prison guard at Auschwitz during World War II, before being captured in 1943 by the Russians.
sentences.zh: 根据阿斯曼自己的说法，在二战期间，他曾是奥斯威辛集中营的纳粹狱警，后来在1943年被苏联人俘虏。

sentences.en: After two years in a prisoner of war camp, he supposedly switched sides to join the Soviet Union's security agency, the KGB.
sentences.zh: 在战俘营呆了两年后，他据称叛变加入了苏联的安全机构克格勃。

sentences.en: Assmann remained in hospital for several days, but that wasn't the last the staff saw of him.
sentences.zh: 阿斯曼在医院住了好几天，但这并不是工作人员最后一次见到他。

sentences.en: After he was discharged, he returned numerous times for further treatment.
sentences.zh: 他出院后，又多次回来接受进一步治疗。

sentences.en: On one occasion, he showed a doctor a German magazine article about an unsolved murder.
sentences.zh: 有一次，他向一名医生展示了一篇关于未破谋杀案的德国杂志文章。

sentences.en: Another time, he joked to one of the surgeons that he too was skilled with a knife.
sentences.zh: 还有一次，他开玩笑地对其中一名外科医生说，自己玩刀也很在行。

sentences.en: But, unlike the surgeon's patients, those on the other end of Assmann's knife never survived.
sentences.zh: 但是，与外科医生的病人不同，那些倒在阿斯曼刀下的人从没有活下来过。

sentences.en: By July, the doctors at the hospital had grown so suspicious of Hans Assmann that they reported him to the police.
sentences.zh: 到了七月，医院的医生对汉斯·阿斯曼起了很大的疑心，以至于他们向警方报了案。

sentences.en: The medical intern that initially treated Assmann had been so convinced that the man was somehow connected to the Lake Buldum murders
sentences.zh: 最初治疗阿斯曼的那名实习医生深信这个男人与博尔杜姆湖谋杀案有着某种联系，

sentences.en: that he'd bagged his stained overalls so that police could analyse them.
sentences.zh: 以至于他把阿斯曼染血的工作服装进袋子里，以便警方进行化验。

sentences.en: Yet, the authorities didn't seem to share their concerns.
sentences.zh: 然而，当局似乎并不分享他们的担忧。

sentences.en: There was one other thing that further convinced the hospital staff they were right about Hans Assmann.
sentences.zh: 还有一件事更加坚定了医院工作人员对汉斯·阿斯曼的看法。

sentences.en: A month after the crimes, a composite sketch of the Lake Buldum murders suspect was released.
sentences.zh: 案发一个月后，博尔杜姆湖谋杀案嫌疑人的拼图画像被公之于众。

sentences.en: It depicted a man with large eyes, a straight nose, and thick lips.
sentences.zh: 画像描绘了一个大眼睛、直鼻梁、厚嘴唇的男人。

sentences.en: He had long pale hair combed backward.
sentences.zh: 他留着向后梳的浅色长发。

sentences.en: His face was round, but he had a strong jaw and slightly protruding red cheeks that were dotted with pimples.
sentences.zh: 他的脸很圆，但下巴很有力，略微突出的红色双颊上长满了粉刺。

sentences.en: The man's forehead was high and was also pimply, with uneven horizontal wrinkles.
sentences.zh: 这个男人的额头很高，也长满了粉刺，并有不规则的横向皱纹。

sentences.en: To hospital staff, the sketch looked remarkably like Hans Assmann.
sentences.zh: 对医院工作人员来说，这张画像看起来极其像汉斯·阿斯曼。

sentences.en: When the sketch was made public, about 50 tips were received as a result.
sentences.zh: 当画像被公之于众后，因此收到了大约50条线索。

sentences.en: While none yielded anything promising, the sketch was still considered one of the most important leads investigators had.
sentences.zh: 虽然没有一条提供什么有希望的结果，但这张画像仍然被认为是调查人员掌握的最重要的线索之一。

sentences.en: It was based on a description provided by a crucial eyewitness.
sentences.zh: 它是根据一个关键目击者提供的描述绘制的。

sentences.en: None other than Nils Gustafsson.
sentences.zh: 不是别人，正是尼尔斯·古斯塔夫松。

sentences.en: Casefile will be back shortly.
sentences.zh: 档案节目稍后回来。

sentences.en: Thank you for supporting us by listening to this episode's sponsors.
sentences.zh: 感谢您通过收听本期节目的赞助商来支持我们。

sentences.en: Thank you for listening to this episode's ads.
sentences.zh: 感谢您收听本期节目的广告。

sentences.en: By supporting our sponsors, you support Casefile to continue to deliver quality content.
sentences.zh: 通过支持我们的赞助商，您就是在支持档案节目继续提供优质内容。

sentences.en: On Thursday, June 9, 1960, four days after the Lake Buldum murders, Nils Gustafsson woke with a pounding headache.
sentences.zh: 1960年6月9日星期四，即博尔杜姆湖谋杀案发生四天后，尼尔斯·古斯塔夫松伴随着一阵剧烈的头痛醒来。

sentences.en: Strange, faint noises accompanied each thump to his brain, leading the 18-year-old to wonder where he was.
sentences.zh: 伴随着脑子里每一次搏动的是奇怪而微弱的声音，这让这位18岁的少年纳闷自己身在何处。

sentences.en: He tried to look and see, but struggled to bring his surroundings into focus.
sentences.zh: 他试图看一看，但很难让周围的景象聚焦。

sentences.en: The problem was his left eye.
sentences.zh: 问题出在他的左眼上。

sentences.en: It was almost swollen shut.
sentences.zh: 它几乎肿得睁不开了。

sentences.en: Eventually, he managed to force his eyes open.
sentences.zh: 最终，他设法强行睁开了眼睛。

sentences.en: The room took shape, and Nils realised that he was lying in a hospital bed.
sentences.zh: 房间显现出轮廓，尼尔斯意识到自己正躺在医院的病床上。

sentences.en: He saw his mother by his side, and an unfamiliar man who looked to be a doctor.
sentences.zh: 他看到母亲守在身旁，还有一个看起来像医生的陌生男人。

sentences.en: Nils tried to speak, but found it difficult to move his mouth.
sentences.zh: 尼尔斯试图说话，却发现嘴很难动。

sentences.en: He strained his eyes downward and saw bandages and a brace of some kind wrapped around his jaw.
sentences.zh: 他向下转动眼睛，看到绷带和某种支撑物缠绕在自己的下巴上。

sentences.en: With great effort, he carefully opened his mouth and asked his mother if he had been in a motorcycle accident.
sentences.zh: 他费了好大劲，小心翼翼地张开嘴，问母亲自己是不是遭遇了摩托车事故。

sentences.en: She hesitated to answer.
sentences.zh: 她犹豫着没有回答。

sentences.en: Nils racked his brain, trying to remember what had happened.
sentences.zh: 尼尔斯绞尽脑汁，试图回想起发生了什么。

sentences.en: He recalled being at Lake Buldum with his friends Seppo and Tuliki, and his girlfriend Irmeli.
sentences.zh: 他记起自己和朋友塞波、图利基以及女友伊尔梅利一起在博尔杜姆湖。

sentences.en: They all went to sleep in their shared tent sometime after sunset.
sentences.zh: 日落后不久，他们都在共用的帐篷里睡着了。

sentences.en: Before dawn, Seppo headed off alone to go fishing, only to return a short while later without a catch.
sentences.zh: 拂晓前，塞波独自一人去钓鱼，没过多久就空手而归。

sentences.en: He resettled in the tent, and all four of them went back asleep.
sentences.zh: 他在帐篷里重新安顿下来，四个人又都睡着了。

sentences.en: Try as he might, Nils could not remember anything that happened thereafter.
sentences.zh: 无论尼尔斯怎么努力，也想不起此后发生的事情。

sentences.en: When police arrived at the Lake Buldum crime scene, they found Nils Gustafsson lying on top of the tent, slightly apart from his companions.
sentences.zh: 当警察到达博尔杜姆湖犯罪现场时，他们发现尼尔斯·古斯塔夫松躺在帐篷顶上，与同伴们稍微隔开了一点距离。

sentences.en: Unlike the others, Nils was clearly alive, though barely conscious.
sentences.zh: 与其他同伴不同，尼尔斯显然还活着，尽管意识近乎全无。

sentences.en: He'd sustained a number of head injuries, but none were life-threatening.
sentences.zh: 他受了多处头部损伤，但都没有生命危险。

sentences.en: The left side of his face was swollen and beaten.
sentences.zh: 他脸的左侧又肿又青。

sentences.en: He had been badly cut along his left cheek, and there was a two-inch cut on the back of his left forearm.
sentences.zh: 他的左脸颊被严重割伤，左前臂背面有一道两英寸长的伤口。

sentences.en: A police officer peppered Nils with questions as he was rushed to hospital, but only received a series of unintelligible noises in response.
sentences.zh: 当尼尔斯被紧急送往医院时，一名警察连珠炮似地向他提出了一连串问题，但得到的只有一连串无法听懂的声音。

sentences.en: The questions continued as physicians worked to stitch up Nils' wounds.
sentences.zh: 在医生忙着缝合尼尔斯伤口的同时，盘问仍在继续。

sentences.en: How was he able to survive the attack?
sentences.zh: 他是如何在袭击中幸存下来的？

sentences.en: Had he somehow managed to squeeze out of one of the gaping slashes in the tent?
sentences.zh: 他是设法从帐篷上被撕开的一个巨大裂口中挤出去的吗？

sentences.en: Perhaps he tried to escape or fight back.
sentences.zh: 也许他试图逃跑或进行反抗。

sentences.en: It was also possible that the two boys who had stumbled across the crime scene early that morning
sentences.zh: 还有一种可能是，那天清晨偶然撞见犯罪现场的那两个男孩

sentences.en: had disturbed the attacker, maybe just before Nils was about to receive a fatal blow.
sentences.zh: 打扰了袭击者，也许正是在尼尔斯即将遭受致命一击的时候。

sentences.en: Police were hopeful that the sole survivor of the brutal attack could provide them with some answers.
sentences.zh: 警方满怀希望，认为这场残酷袭击的唯一幸存者能为他们提供一些答案。

sentences.en: But Nils only responded with the occasional faint moan.
sentences.zh: 但尼尔斯只是偶尔发出微弱的呻吟声作为回应。

sentences.en: Nils was monitored in the traumatology ward for two days before being transferred to the hospital's neurosurgical wing.
sentences.zh: 尼尔斯在创伤科病房接受了两天的监护，然后被转到医院的神经外科病房。

sentences.en: It wasn't until June 9, four days after the attack, that he regained full consciousness.
sentences.zh: 直到袭击发生四天后的6月9日，他才完全恢复意识。

sentences.en: One of his first requests was to see his best friend, Seppo.
sentences.zh: 他的第一个要求之一就是见他的好朋友塞波。

sentences.en: Despite some slight swelling that remained on the left side of his face, the doctors determined that Nils was well enough to be discharged on June 23.
sentences.zh: 尽管他脸部左侧仍有些微肿胀，但医生确定尼尔斯身体状况良好，可以于6月23日出院。

sentences.en: The police didn't waste any time.
sentences.zh: 警方没有浪费任何时间。

sentences.en: At noon that day, they ushered Nils out a back exit to avoid the crowds of reporters lingering outside the hospital.
sentences.zh: 那天中午，他们引导尼尔斯从后门离开，以避开滞留在医院外的一群记者。

sentences.en: He was then driven to the police station, and once settled, began his story.
sentences.zh: 随后，他被开车送到警察局，一旦安顿下来，便开始讲述他的故事。

sentences.en: After he and Seppo set up the tent between 7.30 and 8 on the evening of Saturday June 4, the girls went swimming in the lake.
sentences.zh: 他和塞波在6月4日星期六傍晚7点30分到8点之间搭好帐篷后，姑娘们去湖里游泳。

sentences.en: The boys remained at the campsite, sharing a lager and fashioning fishing rods out of birch branches.
sentences.zh: 男孩们留在营地，分喝一瓶拉格啤酒，并用桦树枝制作鱼竿。

sentences.en: They also mixed some liquor with the soda, but didn't finish it because it didn't taste very nice.
sentences.zh: 他们还在苏打水中掺了些烈酒，但因为味道不太好而没有喝完。

sentences.en: When the girls returned from their swim, they declined to have a drink.
sentences.zh: 姑娘们游完泳回来后，谢绝了喝一杯的提议。

sentences.en: After the sunset at about 9.30pm, Nils and Irmeli kissed and cuddled for a little while.
sentences.zh: 大约晚上9点30分太阳落山后，尼尔斯和伊尔梅利亲吻并拥抱了一会儿。

sentences.en: About an hour later, they decided to go to sleep.
sentences.zh: 大约一个小时后，他们决定去睡觉。

sentences.en: Somehow, the group of four managed to squeeze into the tent's small confines.
sentences.zh: 不知怎的，一行四人设法挤进了狭小的帐篷里。

sentences.en: Turliki took position on the far right of the tent, facing inwards, with her back to the wall.
sentences.zh: 图尔利基在帐篷的最右侧就位，面向内侧，背靠着帐篷壁。

sentences.en: Seppo was next in line, facing Turliki.
sentences.zh: 塞波排在第二个，面向图尔利基。

sentences.en: Irmeli lay on the tent's left side, also with her back to the wall.
sentences.zh: 伊尔梅莉躺在帐篷的左侧，同样背靠着帐篷壁。

sentences.en: Nils entered last and zipped up the tent door, then lay down on his right side, facing Irmeli.
sentences.zh: 尼尔斯最后一个进去，拉上帐篷门，然后右侧身躺下，面对着伊尔梅莉。

sentences.en: He used his leather jacket as a makeshift pillow.
sentences.zh: 他把皮夹克当成了临时的枕头。

sentences.en: Hours later, Nils woke to the sound of Seppo rustling in the tent for his fishing tackle.
sentences.zh: 几小时后，尼尔斯被帐篷里塞波寻找渔具的沙沙声吵醒。

sentences.en: The sun hadn't yet risen, and Nils estimated it was just before 3am.
sentences.zh: 太阳还没升起，尼尔斯估计当时快凌晨三点。

sentences.en: He felt like going for a swim, so he joined Seppo while the girls continued to sleep.
sentences.zh: 他想去游个泳，于是加入塞波，而姑娘们则继续睡觉。

sentences.en: Once they were down at the lake, Seppo perched himself on a rock while Nils tested the water.
sentences.zh: 到了湖边后，塞波坐在一块石头上，而尼尔斯则试了试水温。

sentences.en: It was too cold, so he left Seppo fishing and wandered back to the tent.
sentences.zh: 水太冷了，于是他留下塞波钓鱼，自己溜达回了帐篷。

sentences.en: The girls were still inside, but were now awake.
sentences.zh: 姑娘们还在里面，但这时已经醒了。

sentences.en: A little while later, Seppo returned as well, having had no luck fishing.
sentences.zh: 过了一会儿，塞波也回来了，钓鱼一无所获。

sentences.en: All four then went back to sleep.
sentences.zh: 四人随后又重新入睡。

sentences.en: So far, Nils's story made sense.
sentences.zh: 到目前为止，尼尔斯的说法还算合理。

sentences.en: Turliki's red songbook that had been found at the crime scene had contained a diary-style entry that corroborated his version of events.
sentences.zh: 在犯罪现场发现的图尔利基的红色歌词本里，有一篇日记风格的记录，印证了他对事件经过的说法。

sentences.en: The entry referred to the excursion to Lake Bootham and contained three brief lines.
sentences.zh: 这篇记录提到了布瑟姆湖的远足，里面只有简短的三行字。

sentences.en: The first read Seppo and Nils were drunk, the second that they were up at 2am, and the third that Seppo was in the woods.
sentences.zh: 第一行写着塞波和尼尔斯喝醉了，第二行写着他们凌晨两点还醒着，第三行写着塞波在树林里。

sentences.en: The police urged Nils to continue, but Nils said the next thing he remembered was waking up in the hospital.
sentences.zh: 警方敦促尼尔斯继续说下去，但尼尔斯说他接下来记得的就是在医院醒来。

sentences.en: Investigators were dismayed to hear that he had no recollection of the attack.
sentences.zh: 调查人员听到他对袭击毫无记忆，感到十分沮丧。

sentences.en: They were certain he held the key to solving the case.
sentences.zh: 他们确信他掌握着破案的关键。

sentences.en: Despite continued prodding, Nils was insistent.
sentences.zh: 尽管警方不断催促，尼尔斯还是坚称如此。

sentences.en: He remembered nothing else.
sentences.zh: 他什么也记不清了。

sentences.en: Investigators escorted Nils back to Lake Bootham in the hopes that visiting the crime scene would prompt a repressed memory to resurface.
sentences.zh: 调查人员把尼尔斯带回了布瑟姆湖，希望重返犯罪现场能唤醒尘封的记忆。

sentences.en: The visit didn't seem to provoke anything new in Nils's mind.
sentences.zh: 这次重访似乎并没有在尼尔斯的脑海中激起任何新的回忆。

sentences.en: There was, however, one other option that could be explored.
sentences.zh: 不过，还有一个可以探讨的选择。

sentences.en: Dr Asa Stenbeck, a professor of psychiatry who lectured at the University of Helsinki, believed he could access Nils's repressed memories through hypnosis.
sentences.zh: 赫尔辛基大学的精神病学教授阿萨·斯滕贝克博士认为，他可以通过催眠进入尼尔斯被压抑的记忆中。

sentences.en: After having previously attended a short course on psychotherapy and having had some success with other patients,
sentences.zh: 由于此前曾参加过一个简短的精神疗法课程，并在其他患者身上取得了一些成功，

sentences.en: Dr Stenbeck felt he was capable enough for the task.
sentences.zh: 斯滕贝克博士觉得自己完全有能力胜任这项任务。

sentences.en: In the month after the murders, Dr Stenbeck conducted three hypnotherapy sessions with Nils, each lasting around 30 minutes.
sentences.zh: 在谋杀案发生后的一个月里，斯滕贝克博士对尼尔斯进行了三次催眠治疗，每次大约持续30分钟。

sentences.en: Nils shared no new information in the first two.
sentences.zh: 在前两次治疗中，尼尔斯没有透露任何新信息。

sentences.en: During the third, Dr Stenbeck asked the hypnotised Nils if he'd heard any screams that night.
sentences.zh: 在第三次治疗中，斯滕贝克博士问被催眠的尼尔斯，那天晚上是否听到过任何尖叫声。

sentences.en: Nils replied that he'd faintly heard the girls screaming, crying out that someone had attacked them.
sentences.zh: 尼尔斯回答说，他隐约听到女孩们的尖叫声，喊着有人袭击了她们。

sentences.en: Dr Stenbeck asked Nils what he then saw.
sentences.zh: 斯滕贝克博士问尼尔斯接下来看到了什么。

sentences.en: Nils said that the roof of the tent was on top of them.
sentences.zh: 尼尔斯说帐篷顶压在他们身上。

sentences.en: A man started hitting them with a sharp weapon, maybe a knife, and also a hard weapon, like an iron pipe.
sentences.zh: 一个男人开始用利器，可能是一把刀，还有一件硬物，比如铁管，殴打他们。

sentences.en: Dr Stenbeck asked if Nils had seen the man before.
sentences.zh: 斯滕贝克博士问尼尔斯以前是否见过这个人。

sentences.en: Nils didn't know.
sentences.zh: 尼尔斯不知道。

sentences.en: Then he described seeing blood all over Irmeli's head.
sentences.zh: 接着他描述说看到伊尔梅莉的头上全是血。

sentences.en: Look closely, do you see the man now?
sentences.zh: 仔细看，你现在看到那个人了吗？

sentences.en: Asked Dr Stenbeck.
sentences.zh: 斯滕贝克博士问道。

sentences.en: Nils replied that yes, he could see.
sentences.zh: 尼尔斯回答说，是的，他能看到。

sentences.en: He described a man who was about 30 years old, with long fair hair.
sentences.zh: 他描述了一个大约30岁、留着金色长发的男人。

sentences.en: His face was round and pimply.
sentences.zh: 他的脸圆圆的，长满青春痘。

sentences.en: The man was of average height and size, but looked strong, as though his work involved heavy labour.
sentences.zh: 这个男人身材中等，但看起来很强壮，仿佛从事重体力劳动。

sentences.en: He wore a thick, dark plaid sweater, with green and black present in the pattern.
sentences.zh: 他穿着一件厚厚的深色格子毛衣，图案里有绿色和黑色。

sentences.en: A sketch of the man Nils described was widely circulated, and by the second month of the investigation, nine men had been arrested on suspicion of being the perpetrator.
sentences.zh: 尼尔斯描述的男子素描被广泛传阅，到了调查的第二个月，已有九名男子因涉嫌作案而被捕。

sentences.en: Each was subjected to intense interrogations, but all had solid alibis and were ruled out.
sentences.zh: 每个人都经受了严厉的审讯，但都有不在场证明，随后被排除嫌疑。

sentences.en: As were friends, family and acquaintances of the victiMs.
sentences.zh: 受害者的朋友、家人和熟人也是如此。

sentences.en: The summer of 1960 soon turned to autumn, and the newspapers were no longer filled with near-daily articles on the Lake Boodham murders.
sentences.zh: 1960年的夏天很快转入秋天，报纸上不再充斥着关于布丹湖谋杀案的几乎每日报道。

sentences.en: Eventually, snow replaced the fallen leaves, and as the air turned cold, so did the case.
sentences.zh: 最终，落叶被白雪覆盖，随着空气变冷，案件也陷入了冰点。

sentences.en: Years, then decades, passed with no new viable leads.
sentences.zh: 几年、甚至几十年过去了，始终没有出现新的可行线索。

sentences.en: Police continued combing through tip-offs from the public, yet these seemed to become more and more outlandish as time went on.
sentences.zh: 警方继续梳理公众提供的线索，然而随着时间的推移，这些线索似乎变得越来越离奇。

sentences.en: It wasn't until 2003 that the case's new lead investigator decided to utilise advances in DNA technology, in the hopes to uncover previously undetectable evidence.
sentences.zh: 直到2003年，该案的新任首席调查员决定利用DNA技术的进展，希望能发现以前无法检测到的证据。

sentences.en: Seppo, Tuuliki and Irmeli's remains were exhumed for additional forensic examination, though failed to reveal anything of significance.
sentences.zh: 塞波、图尔利基和伊尔梅莉的遗体被掘出进行额外的法医检验，但未能揭示任何重要信息。

sentences.en: However, the preliminary DNA testing of several key items from the crime scene, including the tent, did yield new information.
sentences.zh: 然而，对犯罪现场几件关键物品（包括帐篷）的初步DNA检测确实产生了新信息。

sentences.en: It was enough for investigators to narrow in on a suspect.
sentences.zh: 这足以让调查人员缩小嫌疑人范围。

sentences.en: Finally, almost 44 years after the murders, police released a statement that a person of interest in the Lake Boodham murders had been detained.
sentences.zh: 最终，在谋杀案发生近44年后，警方发表声明称，布丹湖谋杀案的一名相关涉案人员已被拘留。

sentences.en: By this point, the suspect was a semi-retired bus driver aged in his early 60s.
sentences.zh: 此时，这名嫌疑人是一名六十出头的半退休公交车司机。

sentences.en: But, in 1960, he was an 18-year-old who lived in the metropolitan area.
sentences.zh: 但在1960年，他是一个住在市区、年仅18岁的年轻人。

sentences.en: Police interviewed him nearly a dozen times throughout March 2004, before arresting him on the 29th.
sentences.zh: 在2004年3月期间，警方对他进行了近十次讯问，并于29日将他逮捕。

sentences.en: To the shock of many, the man they had arrested was sole survivor, Nils Gustafsson.
sentences.zh: 令许多人震惊的是，他们逮捕的人竟然是唯一的幸存者尼尔斯·古斯塔夫森。

sentences.en: The police alleged that Nils had been intoxicated on the night of the murders.
sentences.zh: 警方指控尼尔斯在谋杀案当晚喝醉了酒。

sentences.en: He had packed a condom for the trip, and investigators believed he had intended to use it until Irmeli rejected his advances.
sentences.zh: 他为这次旅行打包了一个安全套，调查人员认为他本打算使用它，直到遭到伊尔梅莉的拒绝。

sentences.en: Seppo was then forced to step up in order to protect the girls from an angry Nils.
sentences.zh: 为了保护女孩免受愤怒的尼尔斯伤害，塞波被迫挺身而出。

sentences.en: Their argument escalated, culminating in Nils being banished from the tent.
sentences.zh: 他们的争吵升级，最终导致尼尔斯被逐出帐篷。

sentences.en: Fueled by alcohol, resentment, and adrenaline, Nils then waited for his three friends to fall asleep, before cutting the tent's guy lines to trap them inside.
sentences.zh: 在酒精、怨恨和肾上腺素的驱使下，尼尔斯等三个朋友睡着后，割断了帐篷的拉绳，把他们困在里面。

sentences.en: Then, knowing Seppo's position inside the tent, Nils began to attack him with a rock.
sentences.zh: 然后，由于清楚塞波在帐篷内的位置，尼尔斯开始用石头攻击他。

sentences.en: Seppo defended himself by kicking Nils in the chin, causing his jaw to break.
sentences.zh: 塞波踢了尼尔斯的下巴进行自卫，导致他的下巴骨折。

sentences.en: Further enraged by this injury, Nils took out his knife and stabbed Seppo in the chest and neck.
sentences.zh: 这一伤势进一步激怒了尼尔斯，他掏出刀刺向塞波的胸部和颈部。

sentences.en: By this time, the girls had woken in a panic.
sentences.zh: 此时，女孩们惊醒过来。

sentences.en: As Tuliki tried to escape the confines of the fallen tent, Nils beat her in the head with the rock until she was no longer moving.
sentences.zh: 当图尔利基试图逃离倒塌的帐篷时，尼尔斯用石头砸她的头部，直到她不再动弹。

sentences.en: Then, he focused his attention on the true object of his rage.
sentences.zh: 然后，他将注意力集中在真正让他愤怒的目标上。

sentences.en: His girlfriend, Irmeli.
sentences.zh: 他的女朋友，伊尔梅莉。

sentences.en: Before Irmeli could escape the tent, Nils smashed the rock down on her head, then stabbed her fifteen times in the neck and shoulders.
sentences.zh: 在伊尔梅莉逃出帐篷之前，尼尔斯用石头狠狠砸向她的头部，然后对着她的颈部和肩膀刺了十五刀。

sentences.en: At some point during the attack, Nils sustained a deep gash to his arm and the side of his face.
sentences.zh: 在袭击过程中的某个时刻，尼尔斯的胳膊和脸侧受了深可见骨的刀伤。

sentences.en: With each of his friends now dead, Nils got to work.
sentences.zh: 随着他的每个朋友都死去，尼尔斯开始行动了。

sentences.en: First, he gathered up all the wallets and IDs and other items of some value, such as the keys to the motorcycles and Seppo's leather jacket and shoes.
sentences.zh: 首先，他收集了所有的钱包、身份证以及其他有价值的物品，例如摩托车钥匙、塞波的皮夹克和鞋子。

sentences.en: Then, he disposed of them, either by digging a hole somewhere in the forest or throwing them into the lake, far from where the slaughter took place.
sentences.zh: 然后，他把这些东西处理掉，或者在森林里的某个地方挖个洞埋了，或者扔进远离屠杀发生地点的湖里。

sentences.en: Nils tossed Seppo's shoes into the forest scrub just off the road to the kiosk.
sentences.zh: 尼尔斯把塞波的鞋子扔进通往小卖部路旁的森林灌木丛中。

sentences.en: He then carefully concealed his own blood-spattered shoes under a rock on the other side of the road.
sentences.zh: 随后，他小心翼翼地将自己沾满血迹的鞋子藏在路另一侧的一块石头下。

sentences.en: The man seen leaving the campsite early in the morning was, in fact, Nils.
sentences.zh: 清晨被看到离开营地的那名男子实际上就是尼尔斯。

sentences.en: After disposing of everything, Nils returned to the campsite to continue his forensic countermeasures.
sentences.zh: 处理完所有东西后，尼尔斯返回营地，继续进行伪装和反侦查。

sentences.en: He slashed the tent's canvas to give the impression of a more frenzied attack.
sentences.zh: 他割破了帐篷的帆布，给人一种更加疯狂袭击的印象。

sentences.en: Then, in either a final show of contempt or to fool the police into thinking the murders were sexually motivated, he stripped Irmeli naked from the waist down.
sentences.zh: 然后，作为最后一种蔑视的表现，或者为了误导警察认为这是一起性侵谋杀案，他扒光了伊尔梅莉腰部以下的衣服。

sentences.en: His staging of the crime scene complete, Nils settled down on top of his murdered friends and waited to be discovered.
sentences.zh: 现场伪装完毕后，尼尔斯躺在被谋害的朋友身上，静静等待被人发现。

sentences.en: The year Nils Gustafsson was arrested for the Lake Buldum murders, a 61-year-old woman named Tarja fronted a television crew to break an oath she had held since 1960.
sentences.zh: 尼尔斯·古斯塔夫森因布尔杜姆谋杀案被捕的那一年，一个名叫塔娅的61岁妇女出面面对电视摄制组，打破了她自1960年以来一直恪守的誓言。

sentences.en: Tarja revealed that she had been at Lake Buldum the night Nils and his group were present.
sentences.zh: 塔娅透露，尼尔斯及其同伴在的那天晚上，她也在布尔杜姆湖。

sentences.en: 17 years old at the time, Tarja had been camping with friends at a public site on the shores of the lake when Nils and his group appeared.
sentences.zh: 当时的塔娅17岁，正和朋友们在湖岸的一个公共营地露营，这时尼尔斯和他的同伴出现了。

sentences.en: Nils was drunk and Tarja recalled a growing animosity between him and his companions.
sentences.zh: 尼尔斯喝醉了，塔娅回忆起他和同伴之间日益加剧的敌意。

sentences.en: As to why she never told police of this key sighting, Tarja claimed she had been sworn to secrecy by her group of friends.
sentences.zh: 至于为什么她从未向警方透露过这次关键的目击事件，塔娅声称她曾发誓向自己的朋友圈保密。

sentences.en: While damning, Tarja's story didn't add up.
sentences.zh: 虽然很有杀伤力，但塔娅的说法却说不通。

sentences.en: She couldn't remember the names of the friends she was with that night, other than one who was already deceased.
sentences.zh: 她记不清那天晚上和她在一起的朋友的名字，除了一个已经去世的人。

sentences.en: The public campsite where she said Nils and the others had arrived didn't exiSt.
sentences.zh: 她所说尼尔斯和其他人到达的公共营地根本不存在。

sentences.en: She also claimed she was amongst the crowd when the injured Nils was stretched away from the collapsed tent, adding that there were no police officers present.
sentences.zh: 她还声称，当受伤的尼尔斯被抬离倒塌的帐篷时，她就在人群中，并补充说现场没有警察。

sentences.en: However, one of the people who helped carry Nils was a police officer in full uniform.
sentences.zh: 然而，帮助抬尼尔斯的人之一却是一名身穿全套制服的警察。

sentences.en: Tarja also couldn't describe anything about Nils, Sepo, Tuliki or Irmeli from 1960, including basic physical characteristics like their hair colour.
sentences.zh: 塔娅也无法描述1960年时尼尔斯、塞波、图尔利基或伊尔梅莉的任何特征，包括头发颜色等基本体貌特征。

sentences.en: Nils himself denied ever seeing Tarja that night and rejected claims that there was tension between his group during their trip.
sentences.zh: 尼尔斯本人否认当晚见过塔娅，并拒绝承认他们的旅行期间团队内部存在紧张关系。

sentences.en: Tuliki's writings in her songbook supported his assertions.
sentences.zh: 图尔利基在歌词本里的文字支持了他的说法。

sentences.en: She had made no reference to an argument.
sentences.zh: 她没有提到任何争吵。

sentences.en: Despite this, Tarja's recollections played a large part in the prosecution's case
sentences.zh: 尽管如此，塔娅的回忆在控方的案件中占了很大比重

sentences.en: when 62-year-old Nils Gustafsson faced trial for the murders of Sepo Boisman, Tuliki Maki and Irmeli Björklund in August 2005.
sentences.zh: 2005年8月，62岁的尼尔斯·古斯塔夫森因谋杀塞波·博伊斯曼、图尔利基·马基和伊尔梅莉·比约克lund而受审。

sentences.en: As did a confession Nils had allegedly made while in custody awaiting trial.
sentences.zh: 尼尔斯在等待审判被拘留期间据称做出的一份供词也是如此。

sentences.en: A police officer observed a seemingly frustrated Nils throw himself on the bed in his cell and exclaim,
sentences.zh: 一名警官观察到一个看似沮丧的尼尔斯将自己摔在牢房的床上并大声喊道，

sentences.en: What's done is done.
sentences.zh: 木已成舟。

sentences.en: I'll get 15 years for it.
sentences.zh: 我要因此判15年。

sentences.en: Yet, there was no official record of this confession and Nils himself denied making the statement.
sentences.zh: 然而，并没有这份供词的官方记录，尼尔斯本人也否认说过这话。

sentences.en: He claimed that if he had ever said words to that effect, he would have just been venting about the situation he found himself in.
sentences.zh: 他声称，如果他曾说过类似的话，那也只是在发泄他当时面临的处境。

sentences.en: Casefile will be back shortly.
sentences.zh: 档案节目稍后回归。

sentences.en: Thank you for supporting us by listening to this episode's sponsors.
sentences.zh: 感谢您通过收听本期节目的赞助商来支持我们。

sentences.en: Thank you for listening to this episode's ads.
sentences.zh: 感谢您收听本期节目的广告。

sentences.en: By supporting our sponsors, you support Casefile to continue to deliver quality content.
sentences.zh: 通过支持我们的赞助商，您就是在支持《档案》继续提供高质量的内容。

sentences.en: The defence's interpretation of the crime scene was vastly different to that of police.
sentences.zh: 辩方对犯罪现场的解读与警方截然不同。

sentences.en: As blood spatter was only found on the exterior of Nils's shoes, investigators took this to assume he must have been wearing them when he went on his violent rampage.
sentences.zh: 由于只在尼尔斯鞋子的外侧发现了血迹，调查人员据此认为他疯狂行凶时一定穿着这双鞋。

sentences.en: Yet, analysis showed that the blood on the shoes matched spatter found at the tent's entrance, meaning they were by the door during the attack.
sentences.zh: 然而，分析表明，鞋上的血迹与帐篷入口处发现的血迹相符，这意味着它们在袭击期间放在门边。

sentences.en: Something else might have been blocking the insoles, such as clothing or tent fabric.
sentences.zh: 鞋垫可能被其他东西挡住了，比如衣物或帐篷布。

sentences.en: The defence pointed out that it was unlikely Nils had walked 500 metres barefoot or in his socks back to the tent after hiding his shoes.
sentences.zh: 辩方指出，尼尔斯藏好鞋子后，光着脚或穿着袜子走500米回到帐篷的可能性不大。

sentences.en: Both his feet and socks were clean.
sentences.zh: 他的双脚和袜子都是干净的。

sentences.en: In a macabre display, the tent that the three victims had been slain in was displayed in the middle of the courtroom.
sentences.zh: 法庭中央展示了三名受害者遇害的帐篷，呈现出一幕骇人的景象。

sentences.en: Held up in place with string, the filthy yellowed canvas showed huge slash marks and was stained with blood.
sentences.zh: 靠绳子支撑着，这块肮脏发黄的帆布上有巨大的刀痕，并沾满了血迹。

sentences.en: The prosecution stated that Nils had cut up the tent after the murders to embellish the attack.
sentences.zh: 控方称尼尔斯在谋杀后切开帐篷是为了夸大袭击的严重性。

sentences.en: Yet, blood spatter once again suggested a different scenario.
sentences.zh: 然而，血迹再次暗示了不同的情况。

sentences.en: Analysis showed they were made beforehand.
sentences.zh: 分析表明这些是在事先做出的。

sentences.en: Furthermore, seven of Sepo's stab wounds were found to have been made through the tent.
sentences.zh: 此外，发现塞波身上的七处刀伤都是穿过帐篷造成的。

sentences.en: Only the blood belonging to the four teams was present on the tent, leading investigators to conclude that no other party was involved.
sentences.zh: 帐篷上只存在属于这四个人的血迹，这导致调查人员得出结论，没有其他人参与。

sentences.en: However, only 20 samples taken from 11 locations had been tested.
sentences.zh: 然而，从11个地点采集的样本仅检测了20个。

sentences.en: Therefore, it was not possible to conclusively determine that a fifth person's DNA was not present somewhere else.
sentences.zh: 因此，无法确凿断定其他地方不存在第五人的DNA。

sentences.en: Additionally, many of the samples tested failed to yield any DNA information, given the degradation of the evidence over 45 years.
sentences.zh: 此外，鉴于证据经过45年已经降解，许多测试的样本未能产生任何DNA信息。

sentences.en: Tests did reveal that Nils Gustafsson's blood was present in the exact spot where he claimed to have been sleeping.
sentences.zh: 测试确实表明，尼尔斯·古斯塔夫森的血迹恰好出现在他声称自己睡觉的地方。

sentences.en: During the trial, a disagreement arose between the testimony provided by neurology experts.
sentences.zh: 审判期间，神经学专家的证词之间出现了分歧。

sentences.en: Those speaking on behalf of the prosecution claimed Nils had suffered nothing more than a mild concussion, meaning he could have easily doctored the crime scene after the murders,
sentences.zh: 代表控方发言的人称，尼尔斯受到的只是轻微脑震荡，这意味着他在谋杀后可以轻松伪造犯罪现场，

sentences.en: and that his claims of memory loss were unlikely.
sentences.zh: 并且他关于失忆的说法不太可能。

sentences.en: In contrast, experts for the defence stated that while Nils' injuries were not life-threatening, they were not minor either.
sentences.zh: 相比之下，辩方专家指出，虽然尼尔斯的伤势不危及生命，但也绝非轻伤。

sentences.en: He struggled with balance in the weeks after the attack, during which time he was unable to walk unaided.
sentences.zh: 他在袭击发生后的几周里连平衡都维持不好，期间无法在无人协助的情况下行走。

sentences.en: They concluded that Nils unquestionably received significant head trauma capable of causing brain injury and memory loss.
sentences.zh: 他们的结论是，尼尔斯毫无疑问受到了严重的头部创伤，足以导致脑损伤和失忆。

sentences.en: The trial of Nils Gustafsson for the murders of Seppo Boisman,
sentences.zh: 尼尔斯·古斯塔夫森被指控谋杀塞波·博伊斯曼、

sentences.en: Tullikimaki and Irmeli Björklund concluded in October 2005.
sentences.zh: 图尔利基·马基和伊尔梅莉·比约克lund的审判于2005年10月结束。

sentences.en: The panel of six district court judges retired to consider their verdict, while Nils awaited his fate.
sentences.zh: 六名地方法院法官合议庭退席商议裁决，而尼尔斯则等待着他的命运。

sentences.en: Days later, Nils was sitting at home when he received a phone call from his lawyer.
sentences.zh: 几天后，尼尔斯正坐在家里，突然接到了律师的电话。

sentences.en: He had been acquitted.
sentences.zh: 他被无罪释放了。

sentences.en: The lack of motive and the fact that witnesses had seen another unknown man leaving the crime scene convinced all of the judges that Nils was innocent.
sentences.zh: 缺乏动机以及目击者看到另一个陌生男子离开犯罪现场的事实，让所有法官都确信尼尔斯是无辜的。

sentences.en: Moreover, the blood evidence confirmed that Nils was inside the tent when the attack occurred, and his injuries would have prevented him from hiding the missing iteMs.
sentences.zh: 此外，血迹证据证实袭击发生时尼尔斯在帐篷内，而他的伤势会阻止他藏起失踪物品。

sentences.en: After the verdict was handed down, the prosecution had seven days in which to appeal.
sentences.zh: 裁决宣布后，控方有七天上诉期。

sentences.en: They declined to do so, and on October 14, 2005,
sentences.zh: 他们拒绝这样做，2005年10月14日，

sentences.en: Nils Gustafsson's innocence was final.
sentences.zh: 尼尔斯·古斯塔夫森的无罪身份尘埃落定。

sentences.en: With the sole survivor of the attack at Lake Buldum officially cleared,
sentences.zh: 随着布尔杜姆湖袭击案中唯一的幸存者被官方宣告无罪，

sentences.en: the crucial question still remained – who was responsible for one of Finland's most notorious unsolved crimes?
sentences.zh: 关键问题依然存在——究竟是谁制造了芬兰最臭名昭著的未解悬案之一？

sentences.en: For many armchair detectives, there was still a question mark around one of the earliest suspects,
sentences.zh: 对于许多业余侦探来说，最早的嫌疑人之一身上仍然画着问号，

sentences.en: Karl Gilstrom, dubbed the kiosk man because he ran Lake Buldum's kiosk.
sentences.zh: Karl Gilstrom，被称为“小卖部男”，因为他经营着布尔杜姆湖的小卖部。

sentences.en: From the outset, Gilstrom's violent temper and attacks against people passing through the area had made him highly suspicious to many in the local community,
sentences.zh: 从一开始，吉尔斯特罗姆暴躁的脾气以及对途经该地区行人的袭击，就让他引起了当地许多社区居民的高度怀疑，

sentences.en: even though he didn't really resemble the police sketch of the suspect.
sentences.zh: 尽管他其实并不怎么像嫌疑人的警方拼图。

sentences.en: One individual convinced of Gilstrom's guilt was Ulf Johansson.
sentences.zh: 乌尔夫·约翰松就是坚信吉尔斯特罗姆有罪的其中一个人。

sentences.en: Ulf was 18 years old at the time of the murders and had visited the lake the very same day.
sentences.zh: 谋杀案发生时，乌尔夫只有18岁，并且在同一天去过那个湖泊。

sentences.en: As a young man who was around the same age as the victims, and who always saw Lake Buldum as a safe place to spend time with friends,
sentences.zh: 作为一名与受害者年龄相仿、且一直把布尔杜姆湖视为与朋友共度美好时光的安全场所的年轻人，

sentences.en: Ulf had been horrified by the slayings.
sentences.zh: 乌尔夫对这些凶杀案感到震惊。

sentences.en: He'd also had his own run-in with Karl Gilstrom on the road leading by the man's house.
sentences.zh: 他在卡尔·吉尔斯特罗姆房子旁边的路上，也曾与对方有过一次冲突。

sentences.en: Ulf was cycling along when Gilstrom threw rocks at him.
sentences.zh: 当时乌尔夫正骑着自行车，吉尔斯特罗姆却向他扔石头。

sentences.en: Ulf grew up to become a local politician, and in 2016 he published a book about the case titled The Legend of Buldum.
sentences.zh: 乌尔夫长大后成为了一名地方政治家，并在2016年出版了一本关于这起案件的书，名为《布尔杜姆的传奇》。

sentences.en: In it, he collated many of the clues that pointed to Gilstrom, including his habit of cutting the guy lines of campers' tents.
sentences.zh: 在书中，他整理了许多指向吉尔斯特罗姆的线索，包括他习惯割断露营者帐篷的风绳。

sentences.en: This idiosyncrasy was particularly troubling, given whoever had attacked the four teenagers used this exact method to catch his victims unawares.
sentences.zh: 这一怪癖尤为令人不安，因为袭击这四名青少年的凶手正是用这种方法让人防不胜防地抓住受害者的。

sentences.en: Sometime in the late 1960s, Gilstrom's wife was diagnosed with breast cancer.
sentences.zh: 在20世纪60年代末的某个时候，吉尔斯特罗姆的妻子被诊断出患有乳腺癌。

sentences.en: While in hospital, she made a startling admission to a friend.
sentences.zh: 在住院期间，她向一位朋友做出了一个惊人的坦白。

sentences.en: Her husband was the Lake Buldum murderer.
sentences.zh: 她的丈夫就是布尔杜姆湖谋杀案的凶手。

sentences.en: Although she had initially told police that he was at home asleep on the night in question, now she claimed that she had only provided him with an alibi
sentences.zh: 尽管她最初告诉警方在案发当晚他在家睡觉，但现在她声称自己只是为他提供了一个不在场证明，

sentences.en: because she was scared Gilstrom would attack her and their children.
sentences.zh: 因为她害怕吉尔斯特罗姆会袭击她和他们的孩子。

sentences.en: After learning of this admission, police attempted to interview her again, but she refused to speak with them for fear of her husband.
sentences.zh: 得知这一供述后，警方试图再次对她进行讯问，但她出于对丈夫的恐惧而拒绝与他们交谈。

sentences.en: No physical evidence that Carl Gilstrom was the Buldum Lake murderer was ever found, and the police closed their file on him in September 1969.
sentences.zh: 从未发现任何证明卡尔·吉尔斯特罗姆是布尔杜姆湖谋杀案凶手的物证，警方于1969年9月关闭了对他的档案。

sentences.en: According to Finland's Evening Newspaper, an 80-page police investigation file dedicated to Gilstrom came to light in 2005.
sentences.zh: 根据芬兰《晚报》报道，一份长达80页、专门针对吉尔斯特罗姆的警方调查档案于2005年浮出水面。

sentences.en: Unfortunately, it shed no further light on his possible involvement.
sentences.zh: 不幸的是，它没有为他可能参与其中提供进一步的线索。

sentences.en: Suspicions have also remained around the other key suspect in the case,
sentences.zh: 对于本案中的另一个关键嫌疑人，

sentences.en: Hans Aspen, the German man who sought treatment at a Helsinki hospital the day after the murders.
sentences.zh: 也就是在谋杀案发生次日前往赫尔辛基一家医院就诊的德国男子汉斯·阿斯彭，人们的怀疑也一直存在。

sentences.en: He'd raised suspicion amongst hospital staff due to his bizarre behaviour, troubling comments, and resemblance to the police sketch.
sentences.zh: 由于他古怪的行为、令人不安的言论以及与警方拼图的相似之处，他引起了医院工作人员的怀疑。

sentences.en: Following the release of the sketch,
sentences.zh: 在该拼图发布后不久，

sentences.en: Hans Aspen suddenly shaved off his long pale hair, an act that could have been interpreted as an intentional effort to avoid comparisons.
sentences.zh: 汉斯·阿斯彭突然剃掉了他长而浅色的头发，这一举动可能会被解读为是为了刻意避免被拿来做比较。

sentences.en: Yoram Appalo, who had treated Aspen as a medical intern at the time, was so convinced of Aspen's guilt that he authored three books on the subject.
sentences.zh: 约拉姆·阿帕洛当时作为实习医生治疗过阿斯彭，他对阿斯彭的有罪深信不疑，以至于为此撰写了三本书。

sentences.en: He and Marty Palauaro, a former crime commissioner turned journalist, speculated that the police were refusing to investigate Aspen as a suspect
sentences.zh: 他与曾任犯罪专员后转行为记者的马蒂·帕拉乌亚罗推测，警方拒绝将阿斯彭作为嫌疑人进行调查，

sentences.en: due to sensitive national security matters.
sentences.zh: 是由于敏感的国家安全问题。

sentences.en: In 1997, an ailing Aspen granted an exclusive bedside interview to Marty Palauaro.
sentences.zh: 在1997年，病重的阿斯彭接受了马蒂·帕劳罗的独家床边采访。

sentences.en: During their conversation, Marty asked Aspen directly if he was responsible for the Lake Buldum murders.
sentences.zh: 在交谈中，马蒂直接询问阿斯彭他是否对博尔杜姆湖谋杀案负有责任。

sentences.en: Aspen replied that he would, quote, not talk about the details.
sentences.zh: 阿斯彭回答说，他引用原话，不会谈论细节。

sentences.en: Marty took this as a confession.
sentences.zh: 马蒂把这当作了一种供认。

sentences.en: Hans Aspen died the following year at the age of 74.
sentences.zh: 汉斯·阿斯彭于次年去世，享年74岁。

sentences.en: For many, suspicions that Aspen may have been the Buldum Lake killer were put to rest in 2005 when police unsealed an investigation file that related to him.
sentences.zh: 对许多人来说，2005年警方解封了一份与阿斯彭相关的调查档案后，关于阿斯彭可能是博尔杜姆湖杀手的人怀疑终于烟消云散。

sentences.en: Mika Mörsa, a special reporter for Finland's Ilta Sanomat newspaper, was given access to the entire file and on October 1, 2005, published an article on the findings.
sentences.zh: 芬兰《晚报》的特约记者米卡·莫尔萨得以查阅全部档案，并于2005年10月1日发表了一篇关于调查结果的文章。

sentences.en: The file showed that in June 1960, after receiving the tip-off by the Helsinki hospital doctors, the police had, in fact, investigated Aspen as a potential suspect.
sentences.zh: 档案显示，1960年6月，在接到赫尔辛基医院医生的举报后，警方确实将阿斯彭作为潜在嫌疑人进行了调查。

sentences.en: However, he was quickly ruled out on the basis of an airtight alibi.
sentences.zh: 然而，由于有密不透风的不在场证明，他很快就被排除了嫌疑。

sentences.en: On the night of June 4, 1960,
sentences.zh: 在1960年6月4日的夜晚，

sentences.en: Aspen had shared a bed with his girlfriend in the same apartment as her sister and her sister's husband.
sentences.zh: 阿斯彭和女友睡在同一间公寓里，同住的还有她姐姐和姐姐的丈夫。

sentences.en: According to witness statements by all three,
sentences.zh: 根据这三人的证词，

sentences.en: Aspen arrived at about 6pm on June 4 and woke up on the morning of the Lake Buldum murders at 9.
sentences.zh: 阿斯彭于6月4日下午6点左右到达，并在博尔杜姆湖谋杀案发生的那天早上9点醒来。

sentences.en: Police also interviewed several witnesses who confirmed that Aspen had been painting at a construction site on both Saturday June 4 and Sunday June 5.
sentences.zh: 警方还走访了几位目击者，他们证实阿斯彭在6月4日星期六和6月5日星期日都在一个建筑工地画画。

sentences.en: On Monday, the construction site's caretaker gave Aspen a bottle of wine and the two men indulged.
sentences.zh: 周一，工地看守送给阿斯彭一瓶酒，两人畅饮了一番。

sentences.en: According to Aspen's wife and his regular doctor, he had been suffering from severe stomach pains for some time.
sentences.zh: 根据阿斯彭的妻子和他的常规医生的说法，他一段时间以来一直遭受着严重的胃痛折磨。

sentences.en: After drinking the wine, these pains returned and Aspen called his wife to collect him.
sentences.zh: 喝完酒后，这些疼痛复发了，阿斯彭打电话让妻子来接他。

sentences.en: When she arrived, she found him unconscious and called the paramedics.
sentences.zh: 当她赶到时，发现他已经失去了知觉，便叫了急救人员。

sentences.en: An ambulance delivered them to Helsinki Surgical Hospital, where Aspen was treated.
sentences.zh: 一辆救护车将他们送到赫尔辛基外科医院，阿斯彭在那里接受了治疗。

sentences.en: According to the police file, the stains that were on his clothes that day were paint, not blood.
sentences.zh: 根据警方档案，他那天的衣服上的污渍是油漆，而不是血迹。

sentences.en: In 1978, police checked the foreign fingerprint on a soda bottle found at the Lake Buldum crime scene.
sentences.zh: 1978年，警方核对博尔杜姆湖犯罪现场发现的一个汽水瓶上的外地指纹。

sentences.en: It did not match Aspen's.
sentences.zh: 它与阿斯彭的指纹不符。

sentences.en: Despite the release of Aspen's police file, many true crime enthusiasts remain convinced that he could have been the Lake Buldum killer.
sentences.zh: 尽管阿斯彭的警方档案被公开发布，但许多真实犯罪爱好者仍然坚信他可能是博尔杜姆湖的凶手。

sentences.en: One reason for this is his likeness to the police sketch that was produced following Nils's hypnosis session.
sentences.zh: 原因之一是他与尼尔斯催眠结束后绘制的警方素描极其相似。

sentences.en: There are only a few photographs of Aspen in circulation today, one of which bears a striking resemblance to the composite.
sentences.zh: 如今流传的阿斯彭照片寥寥无几，其中一张与合成画像有着惊人的相似之处。

sentences.en: There is another photograph widely available on the internet that was supposedly snapped at the funeral of Sepo Boisman,
sentences.zh: 互联网上广泛流传着另一张照片，据说是在1960年6月13日赛波·博伊斯曼、

sentences.en: Tullikimaki, and Irmeli Björklund on June 13, 1960.
sentences.zh: 图利基马基和伊尔梅利·比约克lund的葬礼上拍摄的。

sentences.en: The photograph depicts a large group of mourners.
sentences.zh: 照片中描绘了一大群哀悼者。

sentences.en: Standing towards the centre is a taller man.
sentences.zh: 站在中央偏右位置的是一个较高的男人。

sentences.en: Unlike most of the other attendees, he is not looking straight ahead or casting his gaze downward in a solemn expression.
sentences.zh: 与大多数其他出席者不同，他没有目视前方，也没有带着凝重的神情将目光投向下方。

sentences.en: Instead, his somewhat bulbous eyes seem fixated on something to his left.
sentences.zh: 相反，他那略显突出的眼睛似乎死死盯着他左边的某个东西。

sentences.en: His face is angular, with protruding cheeks, a straight nose, and a strong jaw.
sentences.zh: 他的脸部轮廓分明，颧骨突出，鼻子笔挺，下巴坚毅。

sentences.en: He looks strikingly similar to the suspect sketch.
sentences.zh: 他看起来与嫌疑人画像惊人地相似。

sentences.en: Some believe that this man is also Hans Aspen.
sentences.zh: 有人认为这个人也是汉斯·阿斯彭。

sentences.en: This speculation relies heavily on the accuracy of the description given by Nils Gustafsson while under hypnosis.
sentences.zh: 这种推测很大程度上依赖于尼尔斯·古斯塔夫松在催眠状态下所提供描述的准确性。

sentences.en: In the decades since 1960, the use of forensic hypnosis has proven to be unreliable.
sentences.zh: 在1960年以来的几十年里，法医催眠的使用已被证明是不可靠的。

sentences.en: Studies have shown that hypnotised subjects may be more vulnerable to recovering false memories or being overly confident in their recollections, even when such memories are false.
sentences.zh: 研究表明，受催眠的受试者可能更容易恢复虚假的记忆，或者对自己的回忆过于自信，哪怕这些记忆其实是假的。

sentences.en: The six district court judges at Nils' trial did not consider his recovered memories to be reliable in any way.
sentences.zh: 尼尔斯审判中的六名地方法院法官根本不认为他恢复的记忆具有可靠性。

sentences.en: Nils himself has said that he has no recollection of what he said while hypnotised.
sentences.zh: 尼尔斯本人曾表示，他对自己在催眠期间说了什么毫无记忆。

sentences.en: Consequently, the descriptions he provided of the suspect at that time cannot be verified.
sentences.zh: 因此，他当时对嫌疑人的描述无法得到证实。

sentences.en: As of late 2021,
sentences.zh: 截至2021年底，

sentences.en: 61 years have passed since the brutal murders of Seppo Boisman,
sentences.zh: 距塞波·博伊斯曼、

sentences.en: Tuliki Maki and Irmeli Björklund.
sentences.zh: 图利基·马基和伊尔梅利·比约克隆德惨遭杀害已经过去了61年。

sentences.en: All three were laid to rest side by side in the Helsinki Parish Church Cemetery.
sentences.zh: 这三人被并排安葬在赫尔辛基教区教堂墓地里。

sentences.en: In the decades since the tragedy that claimed the lives of his girlfriend and best friend,
sentences.zh: 在夺走他女友和挚友生命的悲剧发生后的几十年里，

sentences.en: Nils Gustafsson has never had any criminal record, nor has he exhibited any signs of being an angry or violent man.
sentences.zh: 尼尔斯·古斯塔夫松没有任何犯罪记录，也未曾表现出任何愤怒或暴力的迹象。

sentences.en: Many believe that the murder charges brought against Nils were a fumble in the dark from a police force burdened by one of Finland's most infamous unsolved crimes.
sentences.zh: 许多人认为，对尼尔斯提出的谋杀指控，不过是一个饱受芬兰最著名未解悬案困扰的警方在黑暗中的盲目摸索。

sentences.en: Nils described how, after his arrest, the police seized his family photo albuMs.
sentences.zh: 尼尔斯描述说，在他被捕后，警察没收了他家的相册。

sentences.en: Some of the private personal pictures within were splashed across newspapers the following day.
sentences.zh: 其中的一些私人照片第二天就被登在了各大报纸上。

sentences.en: During the trial, salacious headlines focused on the prosecution's baseless claims of drunkenness, sexual jealousy, and rage.
sentences.zh: 在审判期间，耸人听闻的头条新闻聚焦于检方毫无根据的指控，涉及酗酒、性妒忌和狂怒。

sentences.en: Hounded by the media,
sentences.zh: 遭到媒体的围追堵截，

sentences.en: Nils and his family were forced to hide in their home.
sentences.zh: 尼尔斯和他的家人被迫躲在家中。

sentences.en: After his acquittal,
sentences.zh: 在他被判无罪释放后，

sentences.en: Nils was found to have suffered deprivation of liberty and loss of reputation.
sentences.zh: 人们发现尼尔斯的自由受到了剥夺，声誉也受到了损害。

sentences.en: He was awarded compensation in the form of 45,000 euros.
sentences.zh: 他获得了4万5千欧元的赔偿。

sentences.en: Decades later, advances in forensic technology tried and failed to shed light on the murders.
sentences.zh: 几十年后，法医技术的进步曾试图查明谋杀真相，但最终以失败告终。

sentences.en: So much time has now passed that many believe the identity of the killer will likely remain an enduring mystery.
sentences.zh: 现在时间过去太久，以至于许多人相信凶手的身份很可能会成为一个永远的谜。

sentences.en: Nine years after the murders, the kiosk man,
sentences.zh: 谋杀案发生九年后，报摊老板

sentences.en: Karl Gilstrom, was drinking with a neighbour named Berrier when he suddenly grew extremely angry.
sentences.zh: 卡尔·吉尔斯特罗姆正与一个名叫贝里的邻居喝酒，突然变得极其愤怒。

sentences.en: Then, just as quickly, his mood switched to one of despair.
sentences.zh: 随后，他的情绪又以同样快的速度转为绝望。

sentences.en: Berrier couldn't figure out what was wrong.
sentences.zh: 贝里搞不懂出了什么问题。

sentences.en: Gilstrom blurted out,
sentences.zh: 吉尔斯特罗姆脱口而出：

sentences.en: Don't you realise
sentences.zh: “难道你没意识到

sentences.en: I'm Bulldom's murderer?
sentences.zh: 我就是波尔多姆湖的凶手吗？

sentences.en: What am I going to do?
sentences.zh: 我该怎么办？”

sentences.en: Berrier, apparently frightened by this outburst, told his neighbour,
sentences.zh: 贝里显然被这番爆发吓坏了，对他的邻居说：

sentences.en: If you are the murderer of Bulldom, then go and drown yourself and do it right away, because otherwise they will put you in a small prison cell for the rest of your life.
sentences.zh: “如果你是波尔多姆湖的凶手，那就去跳水自杀吧，马上就去，否则他们会把你关进小黑屋度过余生。”

sentences.en: At about six that same evening,
sentences.zh: 就在当晚六点左右，

sentences.en: Gilstrom's 15-year-old son couldn't find his father.
sentences.zh: 吉尔斯特罗姆15岁的儿子找不到父亲。

sentences.en: He went out looking for him around the lake and eventually came across some people who told him that they'd seen his father swimming just off the eastern peninsula
sentences.zh: 他在湖周围寻找父亲，最后遇到了一些人，他们告诉他曾看到他父亲在南岸东半岛附近游泳，

sentences.en: on the south shore.
sentences.zh: 也就是南岸那边。

sentences.en: It was a location where he often swam, right near where the Lake Bulldom murders occurred.
sentences.zh: 那是他经常游泳的地方，就在波尔多姆湖谋杀案发生地附近。

sentences.en: But Gilstrom's son saw no sign of his father in the lake.
sentences.zh: 但吉尔斯特罗姆的儿子在湖里没有看到父亲的踪影。

sentences.en: When Gilstrom failed to reappear, police were summoned to Lake Bulldom to undertake a search.
sentences.zh: 当吉尔斯特罗姆迟迟没有出现时，警方被召集到波尔多姆湖展开搜寻。

sentences.en: A short while later,
sentences.zh: 不久之后，

sentences.en: Gilstrom's body was found floating just off the headland.
sentences.zh: 人们在岬角附近发现了吉尔斯特罗姆漂浮的尸体。

sentences.en: Hey, guess what?

sentences.en: She's been at my house ever since.
